This race is going to be close, and our rights and freedoms depend on it.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39457%2E3422442%2EoPWu1A)
Wisconsin U.S. Senator Tammy Baldwin here, Derek.
I’m no stranger to how close statewide races in Wisconsin can be. Last fall, my race was the most expensive Senate race our state has ever seen — and it all came down to just a few votes. **This year, the stakes are just as high.**
**Right now, right-wing special interests are pouring millions into Wisconsin to try to buy a seat on our Supreme Court. And now, Elon Musk has weighed in—making it clear that the far right is all-in on flipping control of the court.**
_We can't let them win._ We have a chance to elect Judge Susan Crawford, a dedicated public servant who will protect our rights and uphold the law. But with the GOP’s megadonors opening their checkbooks, we have to fight back with everything we’ve got.
**[Can you split a donation between Susan Crawford’s campaign and Truth to Power? Tammy

| |
Dear Friend of Liberty,

Did you know that America's Founders rejected birthright citizenship--the idea that someone who is born within our country's borders is automatically a citizen?

This idea--which is a misunderstanding of the meaning of citizenship--is the subject of an ongoing national debate that will have long-lasting implications for our nation.

I'm writing today to offer you a FREE issue of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale College's digest of liberty, that explains the facts about birthright citizenship.

**In this FREE issue, "Birthright Citizenship and Dual Citizenship: Harbingers of Administrative Tyranny," you'll learn:**

* Why the Founders rejected automatic citizenship based on birthplace
* How the 14th Amendment has been misinterpreted over the years
* What reforms are needed to restore the true meaning of citizenship

Since you're a concerned citizen and an intelligent patriot, I know you'll find this issue interesting and informative. It will help equip you to engage in this critical debate.

And, if your friends and family have questions about this topic, you may want to share this _Imprimis_ issue with them.

You can receive your FREE copy of **" Birthright Citizenship and Dual Citizenship: Harbingers of Administrative Tyranny"** at this secure link:

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/birthright-citizenship-imprimis](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/3t7nKROnFha7OSiQoRBXG6Nl8xyh2Qp6-hnFXTX6yalQpdKJjlUHwDdBLCKZnblBJQH3y7HalTcHVjP7ejuwKWiJ9mP8Lo3ZvU4XWlpNYvItR9ojmjELoLNMbHAf8LmYkjEqMLyntVVMsoevMoXwwAW4WGQhfUoysh7mKVI1wbl144qq-i5-JeCTurKYozb1gzE_THvZhrnyNLRQkn4B2QEy0DIJ2H_ca9_lBuPO1ApP9-tWB9AeaKdzM5BbUav_OC-CnsK-OmHscJ52W2Qkvt4777KtXIYov-_zTNI8bG0gHdRWfVquZAThlpuPNdOxKdtw9tyWn0d1YcdfABVHbjuqHHOIVNQZ-ZNi3H_8AO8xW1U7U3V0RPif1JPN1Sqzwj7MGg_AnisOp0BONyKB0Fu2CNfmBfJwFNZNtXn9dfy8SEBhSOLghkatzpl56mMbWPIOokidXJLF5KfWF5u8VDnm/wDAB-LVqGCkydgj43Jan0cpeJzb5BcMD/6)

Please don't delay! Get your free copy right away.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

Ending early voting and Georgia’s current vote-by-mail system Making it harder to register to vote Rewarding extreme activists for filing mass voter purges This agenda has nothing to do with improving elections — just silencing voters’ voices. And we’re fighting back. At Fair Fight Action, we’ll keep exposing the potential harms of anti-voter plans, lobbying against any voter suppression legislation that gets introduced, and building public pressure campaigns to stop this anti-democracy agenda. = | = Instead of trying to hold onto power by suppressing voters, our leaders should tackle the real problems Georgians face — from housing and health care to the cost of living. But this new voter suppression agenda would build on a recent, sordid history of anti-voter legislation in Georgia. [https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/70756F655332783372636F454353396562687376694F485948735343712B763672586D4157707A676459726C636F6733786F6E2B526572766D6752546567474F/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-01-10%20at%208.23.20%E2%80%AFAM.png]
Dear Friends,
In a recent announcement, President Donald Trump has proposed distributing a portion of the savings achieved through the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) as direct payments to low-income Americans. This initiative, referred to as "DOGE dividends," is ultimately another ploy at covering the tracks of the rich.
I’m Gay Valimont, running for FL-1. I scoffed this morning reading headlines on this plan because let’s be honest: a $1,000 check cannot replace healthcare, a well-built infrastructure, and at the end of the day these payments are the same tax dollars Americans are paying to the government in the first place. Getting a small portion of it back is a slap in the face.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/41387142386A774E7046365135634336712B6E44314C70746B766C4D3767502B6D4A48574245553044575A314A556B5836566B4E6E557475354C702B76556970/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-02-24%20at%2010.27.49%E2%80%AFAM.png]
Under the leadership of Elon Musk, DOGE has implemented aggressive cost-cutting measures, including significant reductions in the federal workforce and the cancellation of various contracts. These actions have reportedly resulted in substantial savings, with estimates reaching approximately $55 billion. President Trump's proposal suggests allocating a portion of these savings—potentially 20%—directly to American taxpayers in the form of dividends. Is 80% going to the institutions you just finished cutting, Trump?
The rapid downsizing of federal agencies has raised concerns about the potential impact on essential public services, such as environmental protection, education, and public health. The long-term consequences of such aggressive cuts outweigh the immediate financial benefits to individuals.
Join me today in ending this scandal once and for all. Rushing $10 will put is in a position to expose these inconsistencies and emphasize the voice of Americans like yourself, who work too hard to have everything stripped from them. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gay2025klemail]

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Feds to target "criminals and illegal immigrants" in Houston-area development, Abbott says,**" Texas Tribune's**Alejandro Serrano** -- "Federal immigration authorities on Monday planned to conduct a targeted operation on "criminals & illegal immigrants" in a housing development outside of Houston that's been under scrutiny from conservative lawmakers and media for selling land to undocumented people, Gov. **Greg Abbott**[said](https://substack.com/redirect/027ed50a-885e-41ba-8b5b-967b576846c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Abbott said in a social media post that he had worked with President**Donald Trump's** immigration adviser, **Tom Homan** , "for months" to target Colony Ridge, a 33,000-acre development some 30 miles outside of the nation's fourth-largest city.

Conservative influencers, outlets, think tanks and Texas lawmakers had dubbed it as a safe haven for undocumented people, often painting it as a cartel-run crime hub.

The extent of any enforcement was not immediately clear. Spokespersons for the Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, Texas Department of Public Safety and Abbott did not respond Monday morning to requests for more information.

Abbott said that DPS troopers and special agents are assisting federal agents with the operation.

Any widespread arrests targeting residents of Colony Ridge for their immigration status would be among the most aggressive law enforcement actions to date since the development became [right-wing lightning rod in 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/b9995daf-8a51-41df-85c5-fa7272363b7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The U.S. Department of Justice [sued the developers in December 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/bc5bb541-4ba8-4dbc-8dbe-1e00df0fe054?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) following the outrage -- for allegedly running a predatory lending scheme that preyed on Latino homebuyers.

Texas Attorney General **Ken Paxton** [later sued the developers](https://substack.com/redirect/50411edc-323a-4a9b-9933-d9c8c17958a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as well over similar accusations despite having [received complaints from residents](https://substack.com/redirect/6cf14869-de8d-4f8d-86f7-3e075287083b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for years about the developer's lending practices.

As of midday Wednesday, wind chills at DFW International Airport dipped down to minus 8 multiple times while the coldest actual temperature in the morning was 12 degrees. Royce White

Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA’s collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation – not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read “Free The Uyghurs.” After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc.

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Tina Smith and Ilhan Omar. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

We can draw a direct line from the ineffective representation we have in
Congress right now to the fact that democratic competition in U.S.
elections is almost nonexistent.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250224?refcode=em20250224-36457&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36457_1203867_qWcLyn&akid=36457%2E1203867%2EqWcLyn ]The New York Times: The Death of Competition in American Elections. A
vast majority of 2024 races for Congress and state legislatures were
decided by low-turnout or meaningless primaries. The trend is making
politics more polarized and eroding public trust.

Most members of Congress did not face a competitive general election, and
one-third of members ran unopposed in their primary. Look at deep blue New
York: last cycle, 21 of the state’s 26 House members ran unopposed in
their primary.

In 2024, while 156 million Americans voted in November, only 30 million
(less than 20 percent of general election voters) cast ballots in the
primary elections.

This lack of primary competition and voter turnout means that many
Congress members were elected by a small fraction of the people they
actually represent, which is bad for our democracy. Too many House members
are focused on fighting for corporate and wealthy donor interests instead
of the working people who make up their communities — and that includes

subject: Hollywood is trying to turn our children against us
body:
Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart. | | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=5a250d2ef58540b78f37f4341d1042f6&_e=O5KjV7kWi49MzvEimw3SK0ohJccwoKY83VFw5RkLgGa-zaXJaKHXLWKyFYrmOMRELObHjkiZH0JoxPJgH2aSoUxta-tpWPH0bc8PghXZSfXzaRYXSpvbOS5MFqkv2Dn8v_SoiXUyjthQ5S135wNjTYQOeXPfxAna2CLxY2mpsVF7Casooi5WnlAl3PlF1UYFOO5H7GMAcYMB4LfRPLIXucmkHlisr0qzV-tspE2bOg_4SiwDH-Zofgl_PJSxU52PNC4fV5AXKGP1-IMnZGngEaxAWsC1kFxbasRiNm1hgCxwTfaiflbJeosQBF5c2FJn3BgXdznRuJjCJWLVNlhdIDnF7chbIlS8UtHA81H-QZC8eWxclXHlGKbYqOL1sY2IdScIJvnnwa0lBhAdL1MvFA%3D%3D)

| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great**.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=5a250d2ef58540b78f37f4341d1042f6&_e=O5KjV7kWi49MzvEimw3SK0ohJccwoKY83VFw5RkLgGa-zaXJaKHXLWKyFYrmOMRELObHjkiZH0JoxPJgH2aSoUxta-tpWPH0bc8PghXZSfXzaRYXSpvbOS5MFqkv2Dn8v_SoiXUyjthQ5S135wNjTYQOeXPfxAna2CLxY2mpsVF7Casooi5WnlAl3PlF1UYFOO5H7GMAcYMB4LfRPLIXucmkHlisr0qzV-tspE2bOg-nzGy9ASrJSHc5Ch3bsH3s5lZYtYR150T7HiAPG7q5x5ncnijL5VFF3m1wdi9KcETv_Qe7bXXD6Asz9RpztPQQ_44O9DXtEgNeApVzeXzodsCovhQFDe9TmMhOUAJsj3LTVPy8X_yaqFWpFkFxj08aZ-96vzpsAB6BNmbPn6tQsA%3D%3D)Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you've seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.

>>Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---

---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025.

name: Andrew Yang
subject: The Upside Down
body:
When the obvious needs defending or restating, we’re in trouble. These are strange times in the U.S. when you can’t take much for granted. | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=7acc687c3e&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
| “So . . . I kind of thought that Russia invaded Ukraine.”

I posted this on X, and it got over 2 million views and 55,000 likes. When the obvious needs defending or restating, we’re in trouble.

A friend of mine from Brown told me, “An engineer in the Coast Guard I know who was there for 20 years was fired this week because he was in a new position for less than 2 years, and was thus considered technically probationary.”

I talked to an academic physician in the Midwest. “All of the researchers at my hospital are freaking out. Most all of them are NIH-funded, studies that have been years in the making could be shut down and the people left high and dry.”

A friend who works in government developing infrastructure in New England said to me, “Everything is being called into question right now, we’re not sure what’s going to be real. It’s an awful environment.”
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=c767f8c5ec&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| These are strange times in the U.S. when you can’t take much for granted. The President is upending longstanding alliances and seems to gravitate to strongmen – perhaps because that’s what he aspires to be. Career professionals are cast aside arbitrarily. Health researchers are on the run. Projects that have been on the books for years might get thrown out the window. I have felt for a long time that our two-party system has devolved into the Democrats as defenders of faltering institutions vs. the ‘burn it down’ crew that has come to define today’s Republican Party. Institutional mistrust and polarization, and Joe Biden overstaying his welcome, led to this past November’s outcome. Meanwhile, most of us are somewhere in the middle, thinking that the institutions do indeed need revamping and modernization but that a chainsaw isn’t the tool of choice. One thing that I am hearing is that several prominent candidates are running in ’26 as Independents because they think the future lies outside of the two-party system. This choice will become more commonplace as both parties become increasingly unpopular. Meanwhile, buried under the political news was the fact that inflation in January was stubbornly high and consumer spending is weakening. People are waking up to the fact that Trump doesn’t have some secret plan to lower costs, and if anything his activities – threatening tariffs and mass deportations – tend to be inflationary. The headwinds are picking up. Uncertainty isn’t a great environment for most people – or markets. And uncertainty may be the most predictable thing for our immediate future. Plan accordingly. For my convo with Zach over the current Administration’s actions on the podcast this week, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=baab85ac8f&e=0f227c2ae3). To see what Forward is doing click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=93ddc6c36e&e=0f227c2ae3) – I’m in DC this week for a meeting with a Senator who would like to see our politics improve.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party
[forwardparty.com](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=48acb4ec5e&e=0f227c2ae3)

## NEGOP Update February 24th, 2025
---
| Thank you to so many who are working towards the objectives of the party. What was once the same few people juggling everything has now been delegated effectively so no one is stretched too thin. **Dozens upon dozens** of strong, patriot leaders from across Nebraska have built the NEGOP into a stable, efficient, and communicative organization. Thank you to Laurie Kohmetscher who does a bi-weekly 3rd District Newsletter PACKED full of updates and events.

Email 3rddistrictnews@gmail.com with questions or suggestions.

DOWNLOAD the latest [Newsletter](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=2cfbf3ca36&e=25844e23a8) and [Legislative Update](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=2e1846dc2f&e=25844e23a8)

**Also, we are in full swing of our Political Plan and below is just a sneak peak at some of our goals.**
---
|
## SENATORS' BREAKFAST
---
| _“What good is the warmth of summer, without the cold of winter to give it sweetness”_
John Steinbeck

Our sincere thanks to the many resilient Senators and Legislative Assistants that braved sub zero temperatures Thursday, February 13th to attend the NEGOP Senators Breakfast. GOP leadership took the opportunity to get better acquainted with the Senators and LA’s to discuss upcoming legislation and hearing dates, availability of unique NEGOP resources such as the Public Education Campaign, and communication resources. Thank you to Charlotte Ralston for assisting in the preparation and event planning.

Newly appointed Director of Government Relations - Jeanne Reigle, welcomed the group and introduced attending GOP leaders. She spoke briefly on her goals for this position and said she looked forward to one on one conversations with each senator. Chairman Underwood shared his hope that the Senators would see the GOP staff and headquarters as a constant resource to assist them in their legislative goals. He also shared information on the availability of two databases for their use.

The next breakfast is slated for March 13th, 2025.

Jeanne M. Reigle
Director of Government Relations
Nebraska Republican Party
Chairman Underwood and Director of Government Relations Jeanne Reigle

---
|
---
|
## SENATORS' DINNER - "A CALL TO GREATNESS"
---
| The [2025 Nebraska Republican Senators’ Recognition Dinner,](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=f118df035c&e=25844e23a8) hosted by the Nebraska Republican Party, will take place on March 27, 2025 at the historic Lincoln Station in Lincoln, Nebraska. The event, themed "Nebraska: A Call to Greatness", will honor Nebraska's state elected officials, including State Senators, and recognize historical figures from the Nebraska Hall of Fame, such as John J. Pershing, Willa Cather, and Standing Bear. This special evening provides an opportunity to celebrate Nebraska's leadership and history, while showing appreciation and support for those who serve the state. Attendees can purchase individual tickets or sponsor a table, with tickets available online until March 20, 2025. SEATING IS LIMITED! For more information email [communications@ne.gop](mailto:communications@ne.gop). VIP Reception starts at 4:30, dinner to be served at 6:00. Please make checks payable to: NEGOP (memo line: Senators' Dinner) Mail to: NEGOP 1610 N Street Lincoln, NE 68508 Join the [Facebook Event](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=7093efe665&e=25844e23a8)
[](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=8e2355641b&e=25844e23a8)
---
|
---
|
## GROWING OUR COUNTY GOP's
---
| We have begun an exciting new series of **County Party Leadership Workshops** happening across the State. Spearheaded by CD1 Chair Danna Seevers and using the database compiled by our three CD Chairs, Chris Vail-CD3, Jon Tucker-CD2, and Danna Seevers-CD1. These power-packed **3-hour sessions** are designed to equip County Chairs and Executive Teams with essential tools, training, and resources to strengthen our local GOP's and drive **Republican victories across Nebraska**.

🔥 What to Expect:
✅ **Exclusive insights** from our new Political Director, **Joe Hagerty IV** , as he unveils the **NEGOP’s bold new Political Plan** and an **LD-Specific Data Analysis** to prepare **Get-Out-The-Vote** and **Voter Registration Efforts**.
✅ Discover how to **make your county party effective and relevant** in recruiting local candidates and supporting down-ballot races.
✅ **Hands-on training** with the **GOP Data Center** and **Numinar** to connect with local voters and expand our base.
✅ **Valuable networking** with fellow county leaders to strategize, share best practices, and prepare for the **2026 election cycle**.

📍 First Training Location: **Schuyler, NE**
🗓 **Saturday, February 22**
🌍 We had representation from 7 of our 12 CD1 counties!! A great turnout for our 1st workshop!!

📢 **Coming Soon:** We will also be hosting a **future session at NEGOP headquarters** for members from Seward, Lancaster, Cass, and Sarpy counties—stay tuned for details!

Workshops will continue into Regional locations throughout Nebraska.

💡 Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to gain new skills, connect with like-minded leaders, and help strengthen our party at the grassroots level!
---
|

|
## VOTE RED AUCTION

## POLITICAL LEADERSHIP SCHOOL - F.A.C.L.
---
| This is the first of a series of political and candidate training that will be hosted across Nebraska to prepare for the 2026 elections and beyond.

_If you are ready to DO something to take back power from the politicians and elites for “We The People,” you NEED to attend this class on**Saturday, March 29th, 2025 in Omaha, NE.**

This intense one-day training covers:

**The Real Nature of Politics** \- why just "educating" people alone won't result in change;
**The Biggest Lie in Politics** \- and how the political class uses your convictions against you;
**How to work effectively at the Capitol** \- getting a bill sponsor and a roll call vote despite the leadership; and
**How to put pressure on legislators.**

All of our instructors have years of experience putting these principles to work in multiple states._

#### **ANNOUNCEMENT: Captain Seth Keshel and Dr. Chris Mattmann Join Frozen Odds Movie as Featured Experts**
**We’re honored to announce that Seth Keshel, MBA, will be featured in Frozen Odds, the powerful documentary on Alaska’s citizen-led fight against Ranked Choice Voting (RCV).****Seth Keshel is a former Army Captain of Military Intelligence and Afghanistan veteran. His analytical method of election forecasting and analytics is known worldwide, and he has been commended by President Donald J. Trump for his work in the field. He most recently made headlines by correctly forecasting a 312-226 Trump victory in the Electoral College, with accurate picks in all 56 races for electoral votes.****Captain Keshel proposes 10 Points to True Election Integrity and has identified Ranked Choice Voting as one of the eight cardinal sins of election administration. He toured Alaska in the spring of 2022 while fighting the information battle associated with promoting election integrity.****In Frozen Odds, Captain Keshel will bring his expert analysis and firsthand experience to expose the flaws of RCV and its impact on election integrity.****Dr. Chris Mattmann Joins Frozen Odds as Featured Expert****We’re thrilled to announce that Dr. Chris Mattmann, a leading AI and data expert, will be featured in Frozen Odds, a powerful documentary on Alaska’s citizen-led fight against Ranked Choice Voting (RCV).****Dr. Mattmann’s career is nothing short of extraordinary. He is the Chief Data and AI Officer at UCLA, former Chief Technology and Innovation Officer at NASA JPL, and President of Mattmann.ai. An accomplished author and industry leader, he has played key roles in advancing AI, big data, and technology across multiple fields.****With firsthand experience in RCV from his time at the Apache Software Foundation, Dr. Mattmann will break down its flaws in Frozen Odds, sharing his expert insights and concerns based on real-world applications.****Stay tuned—Frozen Odds is coming soon to reveal the truth behind Alaska’s fight for fair elections.**

**Starting a film project for Amazon Prime, YouTube, etc. – Frozen Odds How do you take on $15 million with nothing but determination, grassroots organizing, and a clipboard? Frozen Odds is a gripping documentary that uncovers the raw power of citizen-led initiatives in Alaska. Following the journey of a small but determined movement, this film reveals how everyday people—outspent 100 to 1 by out-of-state interests—rallied together to challenge the system. Led by an Alaskans for Alaskans who helped write the law and push it to the ballot, this battle wasn’t just about policy—it was about democracy in its purest form. With 400+ volunteers braving the cold, gathering 42,000 signatures when only 26,000 were needed, they proved that people—not money—should shape the laws that govern them. Through intimate interviews, on-the-ground footage, and stunning Alaskan landscapes, Frozen Odds captures the high-stakes struggle against political elites (aka Lisa Murkowski and George Soros, etc.) and the enduring spirit of grassroots activism. Though the campaign fell just 700 votes short out of 320,000, it laid the groundwork for a new wave of initiatives—this time, with three fresh petitions ready to take the fight forward. In a world where billionaires and lobbyists try to control the political process, Frozen Odds asks a bold question: What happens when ordinary citizens refuse to back down?**

| | | Dear Friend,

I hope this note finds you well and that your 2025 is off to a great start.

I am honored to have recently been elected President of the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors.

As I reflect on my work serving San Mateo County, I am grateful for your continued support in helping me achieve so much for our community. Together, we’ve worked to address critical priorities like public safety, housing affordability, and ensuring equitable access to services for all.

While my current role has allowed me to make a meaningful impact, I know there is still more work to be done. As I look toward the future and the opportunities ahead, I would love to have your continued support. Your encouragement, ideas, and generosity have always been invaluable, and they will continue to help drive the success of my future endeavors.

** [David Canepa — Donate via ActBlue](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=f4884f7fce&e=c0babbc643)**

Thank you again for your partnership and for believing in my vision. I look forward to continuing to serve you and our community in the years ahead.

In friendship,

David Canepa

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Feds to target "criminals and illegal immigrants" in Houston-area development, Abbott says,**" Texas Tribune's**Alejandro Serrano** -- "Federal immigration authorities on Monday planned to conduct a targeted operation on "criminals & illegal immigrants" in a housing development outside of Houston that's been under scrutiny from conservative lawmakers and media for selling land to undocumented people, Gov. **Greg Abbott**[said](https://substack.com/redirect/aa7370cc-46b6-4996-8290-eafc664ef2ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Abbott said in a social media post that he had worked with President**Donald Trump's** immigration adviser, **Tom Homan** , "for months" to target Colony Ridge, a 33,000-acre development some 30 miles outside of the nation's fourth-largest city.

Conservative influencers, outlets, think tanks and Texas lawmakers had dubbed it as a safe haven for undocumented people, often painting it as a cartel-run crime hub.

The extent of any enforcement was not immediately clear. Spokespersons for the Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, Texas Department of Public Safety and Abbott did not respond Monday morning to requests for more information.

Abbott said that DPS troopers and special agents are assisting federal agents with the operation.

Any widespread arrests targeting residents of Colony Ridge for their immigration status would be among the most aggressive law enforcement actions to date since the development became [right-wing lightning rod in 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/802fc3a6-7ba8-43ed-92ad-26720e775865?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The U.S. Department of Justice [sued the developers in December 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/46ede7ef-deb2-405a-88b0-e8d87a108b83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) following the outrage -- for allegedly running a predatory lending scheme that preyed on Latino homebuyers.

Texas Attorney General **Ken Paxton** [later sued the developers](https://substack.com/redirect/2a062fec-4821-449c-8e5e-10d1d2dabe5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as well over similar accusations despite having [received complaints from residents](https://substack.com/redirect/7ab32469-7e99-416a-9370-5b97f4bbddda?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for years about the developer's lending practices.

The developers have denied any wrongdoing. Their spokesperson was not immediately available Monday morning." [Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/4b483f03-d559-4a2c-a019-5eae00b717c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

---
| | | Trump is continuing on his rampage of gutting important services Americans rely on, this time setting his sights on the postal service. He’s considering dissolving USPS leadership and absorbing the agency – an independent institution – into his administration. This would be a disastrous decision that could disrupt how we receive our mail – especially for rural and remote communities across the country. Trump has also expressed support in the past for privatizing the postal service, which would definitely have a detrimental impact on communities that are too expensive for private companies to deliver to. The White House is denying these plans are in the works – but we can’t take their word for it. [Join us in demanding Trump keep his hands off the USPS >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T333e2074-965d-4594-84ae-8c24373264c6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Action
subject: CTA Feb. 24th: We Need the SAVE Act Passed Now
body:
Call your congressman today about securing our elections and ensuring that noncitizens are not allowed to register to vote.
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| **** President Trump is delivering on his promises to the American people--it's remarkable to watch. But executive orders alone aren't enough to reclaim our republic. We need **lasting change** , and that means **pressuring the legislative body to do the work they are supposed to do and laws that will undo the damage and make America great again.**
Re-enter **Representative Chip Roy 's (R-TX) Safeguarding American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act**, which requires proof of citizenship at voter registration--a step the law currently doesn't mandate. It also closes loopholes in the National Voter Registration Act and Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Absentee Voter Act that allow noncitizens to register and request ballots from abroad.
We've all seen states discover noncitizens on their voter rolls, only to face fierce resistance from the left to keep those names there. That's why we need a **permanent solution**. When the left insists, "It's already illegal for noncitizens to vote," remember it's also illegal to enter our country without proper documentation--yet millions do it without consequence. The left often ignores laws they dislike, bending the rules to gain an edge. We've had enough.

**ACTION:** Use our [**SAVE Act action page**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a9d30abe/1edb9794a9d2532c) to contact your representative today and tell them to support the SAVE Act. We need to close these gaps, protect our elections, and ensure the Trump administration can truly make America great again. Stay loud, stay active, and let's get this crucial legislation passed.
**ACTION: Please remember** to use our previous action pages to **[Defund and Dismantle USAID](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a9d30abe/1edb9794a9d2532e "https://www.teapartypatriots.org/calls-to-action/defund-dismantle-usaid/")** (you will see two action pages linked on that page that target different members of Congress), as well as our **[Confirm Trump 's Nominees action page](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a9d30abe/1edb9794a9d25330 "https://www.patriotproject.com/petition/trump-nominees")** to let your senators know you want them to continue to support President Trump's nominees.
**_Finally, the 16 th anniversary of the first nationwide tea party protest and this amazing tea party movement--that wouldn't exist without you--is this Thursday, February 27, 2025!_****_
_**Mark your calendars and get ready to share pictures and stories about your involvement with others and on social media.**What we are seeing now with DOGE, President Trump, and Elon Musk is the culmination of a lot of hard work done by you and millions of your fellow American patriots! Enjoy all the winning!!****
**Thank you so much for all you do and have done over the many years!******
**In liberty,
Jenny Beth Martin __ **__** **** ************

## Apple to Invest $500 Billion in U.S. Manufacturing
Apple announced a [$500 billion investment in the U.S.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uhDAQhJ_GdEbr34PCRRq6S5sSLbA-HBmDbN-he_uIVGnSjfRpRqPv6z7eMcSQHp-4kat-HyVIw0FyacYFQ3yPulmcJ5KkGnLipkF3CjrRrA6NsdaSn-yMPRrsrbegb1Ypo0Fo3wR3rYGURgglRN_q3oIRGmFaJivmjmmgJdQ9t997SHUlH9_7i3I771sT3VrrUZj6YHJgcjjPs03TnOgsF2dymJ4lJCrlT-QXZnLA44jEj4ipcAPApxBj2BN_Fh7Si0rdKFVe83M7eMUcvOd1zYSV5zmh6JWGrsluOc6rWOyNaXhsGOLvtfqfqpeTPwEAAP__pRlseQ) over the next five years, including plans for a new manufacturing facility, an expansion of its Advanced Manufacturing Fund, and the creation of 20,000 U.S. jobs. The tech giant plans to start producing servers in Houston later this year, with a 250,000-square-foot server manufacturing facility in Texas scheduled to open in 2026. Earlier this month, the U.S. placed a 10% tariff on all Chinese goods, which could raise the cost of components Apple imports from China for its devices.

## American Pets: Dogs vs. Cats
Almost 114 million Americans own [at least one pet](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O6yAQRp_GdFgw_IQUFLdJl9tuaWEY27PCYNmsrbz9Kum3_75zpPP1HJ6BMpX5f1jRt6kOIMBwARzMkALl16BZ8hMioGLo5U0L7ZRwki3epTHBFNV4E9ECSmfBOBXHeJeTM2gZ-TdNABgplZT3Xt-tMFIHMabRyug6LTBRq3v_Xam0Baf8qifufawry35pbTs69a-DRweP67r6k46fkGPYqIVMR3sPO3iEFXeKofANG69Xwf1YaONUOAjQn7uaa50zDifNBVtDtvu0XZQzHfbWaTGvgfLH2_7qcHr4DQAA___V2mBy), with dogs being the most popular choice at 59.8 million, followed by cat ownership at 42.2 million, according to a U.S. pet ownership analysis. The American Veterinary Medical Association reports that [45.5% of U.S. households](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO8yAQBOCnMR0WrAGTguJv0uVvr7SIWcd7wsGCTay8_Smprrn2G2lGmq_LdImU6X77HzcMvJQJFFipQIKdUqT8moxIYUEEHAQGPRpl_KC8FmswDuPoklU4jtGdrDegXZq9XRanvPWCwrtNAVitB61PvTk5ZbWJ6pquTs--MwoTcan9d6E7r7jkV3li7eeyiRxW5r11w78Ozh2cj-Po43OLfam3Ds4VW3nUGZvkUnL7yF4qN9k4MjWm-Y2PJndkWY471rbS_isVNaT9oJypubEz6rZFyp9p_uuKZ4CfAAAA___DhWJq) own dogs, and 32.1% have cats. Other pets include fish (2.9%), reptiles (1.8%), and birds (1.6%). In 2023, pet spending in America reached $186 billion, and it's projected to hit $260 billion by 2030. Cats are the least expensive pets, averaging $1,311 a year, due to their low-maintenance and independent nature, compared to $1,516 for other animals.

# [A full-scale replica of the Parthenon was built in Nashville.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss8mtj&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [U.S. History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss8mtj&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss8mtj&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| T he Parthenon — an ancient Greek temple built in Athens, Greece, between 447 and 432 BCE — is one of the most famous landmarks in the world. But many people don’t realize that a full-scale [replica](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss8mtj&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) was built far across the world in Nashville, Tennessee, to celebrate the state’s Centennial Exposition in 1897. Nashville had earned the nickname “the Athens of the South” due to its commitment to culture and higher education, and opted to honor the moniker by recreating one of ancient Greece’s most famous landmarks.
---
At the time, the Parthenon in Greece had fallen into disrepair, and organizers in Tennessee aimed to replicate the building as it looked in its heyday. Crews laid the first stone in 1895, and worked for two years to construct the many pillars and other features of the 65-foot-tall temple. While the exterior of the final product was an exact replica, the building’s interior featured a different layout than its Greek counterpart, and was used to display the many paintings and sculptures that were acquired for the exposition.
Initially, Nashville’s Parthenon was built using temporary materials and the plan was for it to be destroyed after the event. However, it was beloved by locals, so the city decided to rebuild the landmark with permanent materials. The structure reopened in 1931, though it still lacked an important original feature: the 42-foot-tall statue of the goddess Athena, for whom the original Parthenon was dedicated. Nashville commissioned work on the statue in 1982 and it was unveiled in 1990. In 2002, the statue was gilded and painted, adding the final touches to the replica.

## There’s a quarter-scale replica of the Statue of Liberty in France.
On July 4, 1884, the Statue of Liberty was gifted to the United States by France. Five years later, France was given a Lady Liberty of its own, albeit a much smaller one. The [quarter-scale replica](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss8mtj&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) was a gift from American communities living in Paris to honor the centennial of the French Revolution. Oddly, Americans chose to unveil the gift on July 4, a day that lacks any notable meaning in France. The statue was initially placed on Pont de Grenelle (a bridge on the River Seine) and inaugurated during a ceremony attended by Statue of Liberty sculptor Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi. Bartholdi insisted the replica be oriented toward New York City, though it wasn't until the 1960s that his wish was granted, when the bridge was rebuilt and the replica was relocated to Île aux Cygnes, an artificial island on the Seine.

clean_body: The Parthenon — an ancient Greek temple built in Athens, Greece, between 447 and 432 BCE — is one of the most famous landmarks in the world. | T he Parthenon — an ancient Greek temple built in Athens, Greece, between 447 and 432 BCE — is one of the most famous landmarks in the world. But many people don’t realize that a full-scale was built far across the world in Nashville, Tennessee, to celebrate the state’s Centennial Exposition in 1897. Nashville had earned the nickname “the Athens of the South” due to its commitment to culture and higher education, and opted to honor the moniker by recreating one of ancient Greece’s most famous landmarks. At the time, the Parthenon in Greece had fallen into disrepair, and organizers in Tennessee aimed to replicate the building as it looked in its heyday. Crews laid the first stone in 1895, and worked for two years to construct the many pillars and other features of the 65-foot-tall temple. While the exterior of the final product was an exact replica, the building’s interior featured a different layout than its Greek counterpart, and was used to display the many paintings and sculptures that were acquired for the exposition. Initially, Nashville’s Parthenon was built using temporary materials and the plan was for it to be destroyed after the event. However, it was beloved by locals, so the city decided to rebuild the landmark with permanent materials. The structure reopened in 1931, though it still lacked an important original feature: the 42-foot-tall statue of the goddess Athena, for whom the original Parthenon was dedicated. Nashville commissioned work on the statue in 1982 and it was unveiled in 1990. On July 4, 1884, the Statue of Liberty was gifted to the United States by France. Five years later, France was given a Lady Liberty of its own, albeit a much smaller one. The was a gift from American communities living in Paris to honor the centennial of the French Revolution. Oddly, Americans chose to unveil the gift on July 4, a day that lacks any notable meaning in France. The statue was initially placed on Pont de Grenelle (a bridge on the River Seine) and inaugurated during a ceremony attended by Statue of Liberty sculptor Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi. Bartholdi insisted the replica be oriented toward New York City, though it wasn't until the 1960s that his wish was granted, when the bridge was rebuilt and the replica was relocated to Île aux Cygnes, an artificial island on the Seine. ---
# **The Market Is Crashing—Why Is No One Talking About It?**
---
|
---
| | | | Hello friend, The market is in a free fall, and yet somehow, that isn’t leading any corporate news headlines. **I wonder why that is.** Things are really, really bad—just look at your own investments. Actually, maybe it's best to save yourself the grief and not do that today. Could it be that the market does not favor **massive layoffs in the federal government**? Or could it be that the free market is reacting to a president who changes U.S. economic policies like he changes his socks? Whatever the case, the market **is not having it** —and for Trump, who prides himself on a robust stock market (one that he inherited, by the way), **he sure as hell isn’t doing a good job there.** It’s not just stocks—the crypto market is even worse, and the crypto bros are having a meltdown. Okay, I’ll admit, I did chuckle at that one—but it’s impacting everyone. My personal accounts are down **something like 30% since Trump took office**. I’m not a day trader, but I’m in a few chat groups with friends who like to trade, and every time I take their input, it proves to be the wrong decision. **I think I need new friends, haha.** But on a more serious note: **why is corporate media giving Trump a pass on this?** Could it be they’re scared of his retaliation? After all, **the AP has been blocked from the White House briefing room,** ABC and Comcast have had to pay Trump tens of millions of dollars in bogus lawsuits that he filed—cases they settled just to avoid his wrath. Or could it be they have **lost any sense of journalistic integrity** —not that they ever had much to begin with? Whatever the reason, **corporate media is not reporting the actual news.** They chase Trump around like a dog chasing a bone, gleefully watching their ratings—and their profits—**soar.** And then comes the **Elon Musk factor** —the world’s richest **supervillain** is profiting in ways we can’t even begin to fathom. He’s openly setting his eyes on being the **world’s first trillionaire** while planning a colony on Mars. Personally, I vote to grant him his wish—put him on a rocket and say goodbye once and for all. Unfortunately, life doesn’t work that way. **So instead, we have to appeal to the American people and expose the truth—because that’s the one thing we are holding onto for dear life.** **And the truth is this:** **Americans—ALL Americans, not just Democrats—do not want to see massive tax breaks for corporations and billionaires.** No one is talking about this, but **the Republican budget proposal includes $3.5 trillion in corporate tax breaks while slashing Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security.** The greed is endless. Nowhere was this ever mentioned on the campaign trail—but here we are. **Now is the time to rise to the occasion and win back the working class of America.** That is our goal for 2026, 2028, and beyond. We are going to win them back—and never relinquish them again. The only way we do that is by **doing right by them.** Democrats are **not** the party of the elites—at least, most of us aren’t anyway. **We have a lot of battles ahead, but we stick together, we push out corporate influences in our party, and we will be victorious.** The fight for the soul of our nation is unfolding. It might feel like we’re weak right now—after all, Republicans control everything. But **we have the people.** And as the saying goes: **The people united will never be defeated.** I’ve been chanting that phrase at protests since I was six years old. My own kids—six and four years old—sometimes chant it around the house before bedtime when they refuse to go to sleep. I don’t think they fully grasp the meaning—but I do, and I know **you do too.** [**_We must stay strong. We must keep fighting. And we must be honest with each other every step of the way. That is my vow to you. I appreciate your support, and I look forward to winning again—undoing the damage that has been done to our country._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wkjss-v7wryu-kyd76rh1/) **It will take time, but we will get it done.** In Solidarity, Hassan Martini

| | Hi folks,
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Senate Bill 70, which targets the sale of stolen goods through online marketplaces, advanced to the House as lawmakers seek to[]() [curb rising retail crime](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Meanwhile, a new bill has been introduced to repeal an exemption in Colorado’s [Open Meetings Law](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) that shields the General Assembly, aiming to increase government transparency.
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Only [40% of Colorado fourth graders](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) meet grade-level expectations in math, raising concerns about the state's education policies and performance.

🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Former GOP presidential candidate Vivek Ramaswamy announced his [candidacy for Ohio governor](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), positioning himself as a strong contender. President Trump appointed conservative commentator Dan Bongino as the [FBI's deputy director](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), signaling a tough-on-crime approach in his administration.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** A new column argues that the state’s [open primary structure](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) weakens party integrity and advantages establishment candidates. A policy deep dive questions how many border agents are truly needed to maintain security amid [ongoing immigration challenges](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, February 25, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Lundberg: Challenging the open primary system in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KEVIN LUNDBERG, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_As chairman for the Colorado GOP lawsuit committee, following is an update on the progress of our case challenging the semi-open primary in federal court._
_Our contention is that political parties, being a private organization, should not be required to allow non-party members to vote in that party’s elections, selecting their nominee for general elections. This legal standard was actually established by the U.S. Supreme Court in the Jones case in 2000._
_In 2021, the State Republican Central Committee unanimously approved a resolution calling for a legal challenge of Prop. 108. That ballot initiative was approved by a narrow majority vote in the 2016 general election and was first applied to primary elections in 2018. It is instructive to note that the counties with a plurality of Republican voters rejected Prop. 108 in the 2016 vote._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[SB 70, taking aim at online selling of stolen goods, advances to House](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Senate Bill 70 advanced to the House with bipartisan support, requiring online marketplaces to disclose high-volume sellers and implement a reporting system for suspected stolen goods.
* The bill mandates that online platforms establish mechanisms to notify law enforcement of stolen goods and implement policies to detect organized retail crime.
* Some GOP lawmakers opposed the measure, arguing that the responsibility to address retail theft should fall solely on law enforcement rather than placing additional burdens on businesses.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Do just 2 in 5 Colorado fourth graders meet expectations in math?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Only 42% of Colorado's fourth graders met or exceeded grade-level expectations in math, showing a slight improvement from 36% in 2022.
* Students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds and minority groups scored 25 to 29 points lower than their peers, highlighting persistent educational disparities.
* Despite gains in Colorado, fourth-grade math performance nationwide remains below pre-pandemic levels, signaling ongoing challenges in academic recovery.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Lawmakers introduce a bill to repeal Open Meetings Law shield for General Assembly](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** L[AW WEEK COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Republican lawmakers introduced House Bill 25-1242 to repeal a provision in Senate Bill 24-157, which had shielded legislative communications from Colorado’s Open Meetings Law.
* The new bill aims to increase transparency by making written exchanges between lawmakers more accessible to the public. The bill would make law enforcement disciplinary records more accessible, with personal details redacted.
* Assigned to a committee known for blocking controversial bills, the measure faces challenges in advancing through the legislative process.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Walcher: How many border guards do we need?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Police have an unflattering nickname, “Permit Patty,” for someone who calls police over frivolous complaints. It originated when a woman called the police on a little girl selling lemonade at a streetside stand – as generations of kids have done – without a permit. It illustrates a commonsense truth, namely that not everything in life should require a permit, and not every infraction is a matter for the police._ ___Most of us instinctively understand that, but the federal government never has. Virtually all government agencies operate from a top-down, command-and-control model that emphasizes enforcement over incentives. And most of them have a law enforcement division to make sure everyone complies with their edicts and rules. The federal government has more police than New York, Chicago, and Los Angeles combined. In fact, there are twice as many law enforcement officers in federal agencies than in America’s 25 largest cities combined – more than 200,000 federal cops._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

It illustrates a commonsense truth, namely that not everything in life should require a permit, and not every infraction is a matter for the police. _Most of us instinctively understand that, but the federal government never has. Virtually all government agencies operate from a top-down, command-and-control model that emphasizes enforcement over incentives. And most of them have a law enforcement division to make sure everyone complies with their edicts and rules. The federal government has more police than New York, Chicago, and Los Angeles combined. In fact, there are twice as many law enforcement officers in federal agencies than in America’s 25 largest cities combined – more than 200,000 federal cops. | ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ RMV STAFF | COMMENTARY | FEBRUARY 23 Heidi Ganahl is back, and she’s on fire. In the latest episode of Unleashed, she dives into the urgent fight to restore freedom in Colorado—breaking down how grassroots activism, coalition-building, and an unapologetic commitment to conservative values will shape the future of our state. DRAKE HUNTER| COMMENTARY | FEBRUARY 22 During my military career, while on a special task force, I needed to qualify in “high ropes” to master rappelling from skyscrapers, steep mountains or any necessary situation. JEN SCHUMANN| LOCAL | FEBRUARY 22 A battle is brewing over the future of Sandstone Ranch Open Space. Douglas County’s proposal to introduce primitive camping at the site has sparked overwhelming opposition from residents, firefighters and local organizations. The bison is North America's largest land mammal , with males standing up to 6 feet tall and weighing up to 2,000 pounds. Yellowstone National Park, home to nearly 5,000 bison, is the only place where they have lived continuously since prehistoric times. | CARTOON OF THE DAY | QUOTE OF THE DAY "It is often the small steps, not the giant leaps, that bring about the most lasting change." — Queen Elizabeth II | | | | ---|---|--- Did a friend forward you this email? | A product of Rocky Mountain Voice, Inc. 8200 S Quebec St, STE A3601 Centennial, CO 80112 This message was originally sent to: dpwillis67@gmail.com Be sure to put “RockyMountainVoice.com” on your safe-senders whitelist. As for the cesspool of right-wing owned social media, from Musk to Zuckerberg, we will be part of the antidote to their worldwide virus of lies, conspiracies and autocracy.
So watch the livestream marathon today with some of our best independent media and political folks out there. And actors. And a comedian. And a rock star. We aim to educate but also entertain. And be sure to subscribe to the Substack if you haven't yet, because from our surprise announcements today to plans for the future, you ain't seen nothing yet.

body:

| Peter, Did you see this win for common sense this week? Congestion Pricing is officially dead! The Trump Department of Transportation has officially ended New York City’s outrageous $9 rush hour toll. President Trump’s new Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy called the MTA’s toll “a slap in the face to working-class Americans and small business owners” before rescinding its federal approval. And he’s absolutely right. The death of congestion pricing is a huge win for New Jersey families. Want to see more wins like this? We at the Common Sense Club are exposing all the BS and lunacy around us, bringing a voice of reason and giving the megaphone back to common sense New Jerseyans. But we can’t do it without your help! Would you consider chipping in today? Any amount will help us save our state from (very costly!) Left Wing lunacy.

# Freedom Fight Rally Rundown
---
| |
---
| TFVC has always been able to act quickly and adapt to rapid, unexpected changes at the Capitol, but last week’s Freedom Fight Rally tested our flexibility! From shifts in our speaker lineup to weather hiccups, we proved that **no one can rain on our parade**. Once we moved the “rally” indoors, our huge crowd was joined by about **TWO DOZEN champion lawmakers** , documentarian Mikki Willis, Congressman Chip Roy and news personality Sara Gonzales, who shook the walls of the conference room with **their fiery speeches**! Rally goers were then among the first in the nation to see the trailer for Mikki Willis’ newest film project,**“Follow the Silenced”** , a documentary by Director Matthew Guthrie telling the stories of those injured during the COVID vaccine trials. Stay tuned for screening opportunities! Our birthday celebration wrapped up with an **insightful legislative panel** , and it was so encouraging to hear Representatives giving credit to **TFVC’s grassroots efforts** to protect medical liberty and amplify the message of vaccine choice with legislators. Reflecting on this powerful event, it’s impossible to overstate the impact that **YOU** have had on the tremendous progress we have made in ten years. What was once seemingly unimaginable is now within sight, and that is all thanks to your commitment to our movement!

clean_body: | | | | | | | Freedom Fight Rally Rundown | | | TFVC has always been able to act quickly and adapt to rapid, unexpected changes at the Capitol, but last week’s Freedom Fight Rally tested our flexibility! From shifts in our speaker lineup to weather hiccups, we proved that no one can rain on our parade. Once we moved the “rally” indoors, our huge crowd was joined by about TWO DOZEN champion lawmakers , documentarian Mikki Willis, Congressman Chip Roy and news personality Sara Gonzales, who shook the walls of the conference room with their fiery speeches! Rally goers were then among the first in the nation to see the trailer for Mikki Willis’ newest film project,“Follow the Silenced” , a documentary by Director Matthew Guthrie telling the stories of those injured during the COVID vaccine trials. Stay tuned for screening opportunities! Our birthday celebration wrapped up with an insightful legislative panel , and it was so encouraging to hear Representatives giving credit to TFVC’s grassroots efforts to protect medical liberty and amplify the message of vaccine choice with legislators. Reflecting on this powerful event, it’s impossible to overstate the impact that YOU have had on the tremendous progress we have made in ten years. What was once seemingly unimaginable is now within sight, and that is all thanks to your commitment to our movement! | | | News | | | | | | 10th Birthday Recognitions | To commemorate TFVC's TEN YEARS fighting tyranny, TFVC's work was recognized in both chambers! A big thank you to Sen. Mayes Middleton and Rep. Mitch Little for honoring our efforts! | | | | Dr. Bowden Testifies | TFVC coordinated with Dr. Mary Talley Bowden at a recent Senate Appropriations Hearing. Dr. Bowden courageously took on the corrupt Texas Medical Board for its political persecution, which is committed at the taxpayers’ expense. | | | | | | | | New Website. New Look. | Check out the new TFVC website! It’s dynamic, accessible, and beautiful! Loaded with modern resources, refreshed advocacy tools, and up to date information, check out the newest hub for all things vaccine choice in Texas. | | | | Share Your Story | We know that the experiences of the vaccine injured are often dismissed or ignored. body:
Watchfulness of the Citizen | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e795666d2342/n41kepo7ku-12731688?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=199e471d8b&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

__
Seek - Biblically “Seek first” is defined as **seeking in order to find, to aim at or strive after.**
Pursue - means **to chase something.** Believers pursue godly behavior to better themselves and to help others.

PEACE - The term "peace" is used in the New Testament in at least four different ways:
(1) peace as **the absence of war or chaos** ,
(2) peace as a right relationship with God or with Christ;
(3) peace as a good relationship among people;
(4) peace as an individual virtue or state, that is, tranquillity or serenity;

_"Remember, it is sin to know what you ought to do and then not do it."_
* * *
I've been told over my 49 different newsletters that I make them too loooong. Today's culture doesn't want to immerse in reading and our attention spans don't quite match lengthy reading that isn't set to a fictional entertainment.

My reason for lengthy diatribes on the topics for each email is to delve into all corners of a topic and attempt to reduce down nay-sayers or any misunderstanding to the message. I've found with politics that many folks are more apt to ASSUME and CONCLUDE and be OFFENDED, which unfortunately means any of the insight or perspective of any newsletter or informative document is lost.

So here is a brief thought for this newsletter. We have a Unicameral motto that is...

_**"The Salvation of the State is Watchfulness in the Citizen”**_
It is a quote by Nebraska philosopher Hartley Burr Alexander. It is inscribed above the main entrance to the Nebraska State Capitol. The quote is a reminder that citizens have a responsibility to work for a better life and to be vigilant in their democracy. Alexander's father taught him this idea. The quote is based on the idea that an informed electorate is the foundation of democracy. The Founding Fathers understood the importance of this and made Freedom of the Press one of the five freedoms guaranteed by the Constitution.

**So, I encourage all Citizens to Watch a day at the Unicameral.** Just sit in the balcony. See, watchfulness doesn't have to imply the "Gotcha" concept or the "keep an eye" on the Senators.

**Just sit in the balcony and observe the process.**

Is it collaborative?
Is it efficient?
Is it _REPRESENTATIVE?_
Is it functional?
**Does it stay germane (on task) to the bill being discussed?**
Does there seem to be direction and flow?
Does it have purposeful communication and outline for the day?

Secondly, so far in this session there are 715 bills that have been presented and 50+ LR/LRCA's. For each Senator that's approximately 15 documents that have been drafted.

As I recall, [all 49 Senators](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=27c34d4dc3&e=25844e23a8) CAMPAIGNED on approximately 3-5 main points. They used narratives like defend or protect or fight, for/against the seemingly IMPORTANT issues that concerned voters like taxes, education, elections, fiscal responsibility, public safety, infrastructure, etc. Or they had groups of constituents they were dedicated to representing like Veterans or youth or demographics.

Have you read some of the bills? Have you read the summary statements? I would estimate that over 50% of the bills being processed through ANY given year of the Unicameral have NOTHING to do with what a Sponsoring Senator CAMPAIGNED on. Why is that?

[_**Where do ALL these bills come from?**_](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=523ea98e25&e=25844e23a8)

Also, there are [16 NEW Senators](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=7877a408d2&e=25844e23a8), they've had an impressive amount of research and discernment in less than 2 months to produce SO much legislation. [](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=f768400219&e=25844e23a8) So, I ask the question again..._**where do ALL these bills come from?**_ I don't ask this out of ignorance more of...curiosity, out of being watchful....that **THIS** is the process that we've come to EXPECT? Or, let me rephrase this so I don't offend anyone..._**is this the way the process is SUPPOSED to work?**_ The narrative over and over again is..._"you don't know what it's like within the walls of the Unicameral"_... and therefore...it is what it has to be?!?

_**Which is why I strongly URGE ALL CITIZENS...YOU need to watch IN-PERSON, the morning floor session and an afternoon committee hearing.**_
The truth shall set us free.

## Abbott Orders Lottery Investigation
Gov. Greg Abbott directed the Texas Rangers to [investigate two controversial lottery drawings](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLvOozAQhZ8GOiN7MLfCxTZ02XZLZOyBzMaxkT0KyduvyNZ_ey6fjs6f23KzFCjuv-0TDb-3tICETkgQ0C3eUvgsuvZmlX5SNRo1aKknpca2vptWSbdZ9OBgRK8nHKyEAcG36-jX1tZkLpgE6FSrezU1E_Trptdu7HUHFvtKS_TEKTd8R8a3LVv4pBfmxqVnHcyd-ShV-6uCuYL5PM_m8bbxMiuYI56lgvlbE0cKxOQuYb8AMWXhKaPjIv4nso075iI4CYovLEy7ZRQZHUYWITFj_oi_1j2OxOKkeLHqbPxxUghU-qHScn9aCt9x_ONbLwP_AgAA____NHC-) yesterday. This follows recent criticism of the Texas Lottery Commission for selling tickets through courier services, which buy tickets from retailers on behalf of customers who have purchased them online. Last week, an Austin retailer operated by the courier service that facilitated the transaction sold a winning ticket for an $83.5 million jackpot, eliciting a visit to the establishment by Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick. In April 2023, an entity named Rook TX purchased nearly every possible number combination to [win a $95 million jackpot](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O5CAQhJ8GZ4ygwTYEBJc420svHPHT9nDLmBHutddvf_Lo0s26VdL3qerPx_3D55LX5bd_oqPvud5BQM8FcOjvyedy3nWXXBDJyg6dHLXQVkqjuocLiB60lUYlNNIIZa0UUatxDtAnG7vsLpgA6KXSg7Q3C0OYdejNoHvwODAtMGWq7UYPJPz221zOumO7xfrsinsQvTamfjGYGEzHcdw-9y-8QgaTb5RjQQbTisfGYCqVCNvJYHqj-P-f53XHjfLiKdeVx7pSuxzbyWMtBc89l4J8abhwH0Il4n99_HxV4rF-tYyNb9j2HPGSgBl5GPoofEzcyDlwna7LhMAVzElJMScRx6659DpyKXkbRqbF8vS5vGvRjzvvDv4FAAD__8A3gkU). Abbott’s directive came just hours after the Texas Lottery Commission announced it would [prohibit the use of courier services](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAYhJ8Gb1jwG4g9MHTxlq4dLQw_CSqYCKidvH3lSB073XD6Tqfv67pcTYhhu32ahLo9fV6AgaQMKMjFmRBfi-icXpmbeIeaXwQTE-fj0N31pDj3ivtxcNYKVEz5yVvprbRwcaPqgj7HGIDkg1B86idQqxerHJWQYFARwdCFlkvf7tjwaaqPr7xj6W1OXdT31h6VDB8EZgLzcRz999NsZ0lg3vCoBOY39pc05tawvKjNKYVaQ95oyjtW2jJdzUZt_ikBC61Y9mDxBLui3eMIMYaqLkSwWzIhvg-0f43sGn4DAAD__05RZTk) to purchase lottery tickets. Patrick stated that the abrupt announcement, made before commission officials were scheduled to testify before lawmakers in the House and Senate, gives him “even less confidence in the integrity of the Lottery Commission.” The new policy “does not solve the issue,” Patrick continued, threatening to abolish the lottery if it isn’t more transparent about its operations. A statement from the Coalition of Texas Lottery Couriers lamented the change, explaining the commission previously denied it has the authority to regulate couriers. Yesterday’s developments follow the [Friday resignation](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGvozAQhH-N6TayF-NAQXEN3bv2ymixl7A6gyPbCo9_fyLSla-aYqRPM9-fr8cXSZT9-Zs2Huv3kh6osQONgN0jkMTzYZswzjoMpuHR3K22gzF926yjMb4LFEhb77hnx_Pi_WC1N3YO1odGxgumETvTWmeG24BuXuzc9c52SOyU1RykpnyrK1f-prLEM70533zamjiutb6Kan8pnBROx3HcjoXoKhVOlKv4yAqnnY-icIrJU1Q4fUD_E2KqlfMJPm2blCJp5ww-Uv4LZZO6QuYiz70AbRKgrpIDvCjXEwrnt3gGn_aar1XlVDhhf4e2s62Zew3L7DzY0Hnoh8EDLS1Z17tLRJPH8DokRinurqx-biTx86v-KPo94r8AAAD__9qWglo) of Texas Lottery commissioner Clark Smith, who was appointed to the five-member commission by Gov. Abbott in 2023.
## ICE Raids South Texas Bakery
The owners of Abby's Bakery in Los Fresnos were [arrested during a “worksite enforcement action”](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GurCAYBOCngQ4DvwhaUNzGbm97SoPwq2RRN0CW9e1P3P7038xkfh7Tw4YYjvW_3dGUz3JOwKFjHBh0k7chXpOk3szcD4KiEVpyOQjRt3QzCt0gnfVKKjEsvXDgpdZ2Vq1ftHZAg7nLOEAn2ts0A6h5kXPXK9mBRUUkRx_KmZqyYcGPzUu8zjemxp07jWYr5ZVJ-4_ASGCstTYH1lwRnzcgMAaHLNngM_um2WyfmC62hzXZo2QGvJXANU3Gv2qIMWSlieTrbkP8bpQ_T78N_AYAAP__7fBZcA) on Feb. 12, when federal immigration officials found eight illegal immigrants at the bakery. According to court testimony, the workers were paid $8 an hour and lived next to the bakery in a facility with six beds along a wall, no kitchen, and windows covered with cardboard. They have reportedly been [deported to Mexico](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFuwyAYBOCnwRsW_MbEHhi6eEvXjhaYnxgFgwUkjt--SrYOXU-nT6f7uc5X7YOPt2-9oaovl2Zg0FMGFPrZah_OWTRWGWZH3qDiF8HEyPnQNavSnXS9NM45HBe2XKQe3DBY00vnRrsMjVdvjAH0vBOSj-0I0jhh-kGKHjRKIhhaX1Nu64oVX7q4cKYn5nZJWxPUWuteSPdFYCIwHcfRbmfRUceaok_vEoEp4lEITCU96ko_CIFJ5-qXgH9zqo05aaFG3zGf9BFtWh4bxoqWHinfMRcKjA8cRtHu695kZffDh-CLvBDBbpv24TOt_vvVU8FvAAAA__8QcW60). The owners, Leonardo Baez and Nora Alicia Avila-Guel, admitted they [knew the employees were in the country illegally](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL3u3CAQxJ8Gd5xgjb8KijR0lzaltRhsr7I2J0B357ePnP7fjWakmdHvz3N-IjGd2288oq3fNc2goJMKJHRzQOJrNk2wXoVJN9HqwSgzaT22zW6XIbQ44uA73Y7T4vul1WM3hHYIfgUVG7J3mQLodGt6PT0m6P1qfDf2pgOMvTAqBqopP-oea_xiWflK75gfSzoatnutryLaXwKcAHdceXvfiQDHaUGWZ_wUAe5eEeAU3FoLcAsyy5rkXkhWekmmM0qO4fboOGjLWCmdMiMFiVVyKnLNsZypSI9_Y74EuCbb8PoQM5V-EEZtBxL_P1Z_JPW28C8AAP__nPFqcA). They were charged with “bringing in and harboring aliens and aiding and abetting the harboring of aliens.” The operation was initiated by a call received by the Homeland Security Investigations tip line in December. Baez and Avila-Guel each [posted a $100,000 bail](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFugzAQxvGnsTcj-7AJDB66sKVrR3TGR2L1giNsQXj7KlXXjp_06Tf8v67TFROn9faJD_L1teQJNDilQYGbIiY-JyujDzoORpI3F6vtYEzfyruPJkSLve5b10erjQshdPNih1mj6XGRyb8xDeBMazszNAN0YbHB9Z11gNQJqymmmrem3qnSC8vCZ95pa-b8kOzvtT6LaD8EjALG4ziaHZnpnGmtG_L7JWBc6SgCRs4zsvobGMJZVMBv2k6Vj5W2op65VBUwsYBRbj4-j8ScSncRVt8emH49Wf_NsHv4CQAA___rymDK) yesterday.
## Nation's First Holographic Zoo Opens in Austin
Zoocade, the [nation’s first holographic zoo](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGTgyAUhH8NdjjwfJJQUKSxy5V3pYPxEZlDcYBokl9_Y_ord3dmd-f7ufZX64Nf7l92JlOeLvYgoOUCOLT9aH149ViNZhCjlhUZeUKBWspzU01GO404OhQ3aQc9DEo7d3KAqrEWGhSVN0eZAGhlg0rqWoMaHA7tWWELlhRDQaMvMdVlokJPm114xY1SfYtzFcxUyppZc2HQMej2fa_nvBwZg44W_sgMupLsRoFBt9B-aOdTLnyKId6TXSd_4-8YuV94mYg_Ms9UMn-sH-dYZNDZxC8X-Z6_f89VMuO6-xB8VieG4j5bHz5vyr94NgN_AQAA__8Jm2g5), has opened in Austin. For $25, visitors can experience laser-projected animals in a 60-foot tunnel during one of three 25-minute shows. Two shows feature animals from Africa or Australia, while a third allows guests [to see dinosaurs](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OwyAQBOCngY4IFkzsguIaulx7pbX8OEbC3sjm8vf0J6e_dkb6Rpqfy3jBUst6_cYlu_acaAQJnZAgoBsTlvoaDU8uyDQonp06G2kGpXrNZycB0AYElWKvdU5Katn3CFPEISYVeHEHJgE6pY1Vw2kAGyYTut6aDjBbZmROpdF2anNu-Yn7VF90z9sp0sKrm1u77Ux_MfAMfKhEleh2lAx8y3FeqdL1xcCv-bEz8G-iiCmL-cg3XMSbSODv3soqPj4DzzeXbo9Sa9ntmRl5XbDUz2D794G7g78AAAD___WtXyE). _TIME Magazine_ named the technology powering the experience one of the “Best Inventions of 2023.” Local entrepreneur Reva Enzminger [brought the concept to Austin](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2PhCAQQH8NdpphBFYLimvo9torzSyMKwmKQfbz11_2-utf3kvez3k6U0xxu37TyrY-5zwhoG4BW9RToJhek2qCvUAYZcNWnhSoUcqhbxar9cAwQA-a4KRmDwbYh1GRGow2PjTRfmSAqGWvjBy7Ec1lVhc9GKWR2AgFHGLNpasLV37SMadXvnPpfF6bZJda90P0XwKdQBcoJTo6f0v1Vnil_UMJdBs_DoGOt8qlUtxW3qpA987ZU-B2ySlfC-1L9O07Z4GuKTbsj5hSPMxJKLiuFNNfsv774G7xNwAA__89EV9f) after experiencing it in Australia. # Vivek Ramaswamy announces candidacy for Governor of Ohio
[](https://substack.com/redirect/d325cda6-2ec1-4c7c-bc57-a163dfc962ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Donald Trump and Elon Musk endorsed Vivek Ramaswamy for Ohio governor on Monday, backing the entrepreneur in the 2026 race to replace term-limited Gov. Mike DeWine. Ramaswamy, who ran against Trump in the 2024 GOP presidential primary, announced his candidacy earlier that day in Cincinnati.
Trump praised Ramaswamy on Truth Social, calling him "something SPECIAL" and noting his youth, strength, and smarts. "He will be a GREAT Governor of Ohio," Trump wrote, offering his "COMPLETE AND TOTAL ENDORSEMENT." Musk, a senior Trump advisor, echoed the support on X, saying, "Good luck, you have my full endorsement!"
Ramaswamy, 39, launched his campaign at a rally, vowing to make Ohio "the state of excellence in America." He previously co-led Trump's Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) with Musk but exited before Inauguration Day to focus on the gubernatorial bid. Speculation of a rift with Musk followed, which Ramaswamy denied.
The endorsements came hours after Ramaswamy's announcement, signaling strong backing from Trump's inner circle. Top advisors to Vice President JD Vance, including Andy Surabian and Jai Chabria, are aiding Ramaswamy's campaign, along with pollster Tony Fabrizio and ally Arthur Schwartz. Ohio Attorney General Dave Yost also seeks the GOP nomination, setting up a competitive primary.

# THE BUDGET
---
| TAX REBATES
* $1.1 billion in tax cuts, primarily through one-time tax rebates of $200 for individuals and $400 for couples filing jointly
* the standard deduction will increase by $250 for individuals and $500 for couples, while the refundable portion of the Earned Income Tax Credit will rise from 15% to 20%
* The new shift in tax policy also means those married with two children earning $30,000 annually will receive $1,000 back during tax season to provide financial relief and offset the increase in gas, groceries and living prices.

BONUSES
* bonuses for teachers and state employees
* Commonwealth employees will receive a 1.5% bonus
* teachers and public school employees will receive $1,000 bonuses

EDUCATION
* Limits on state funding for student support positions have been removed, allowing schools to hire 4,725 staff members to assist students.
* $52.8 million in flexible funding to support learning aids and assistive technology.

FLOOD RECOVERY FUNDING
* $100 million in flood recovery funding, including $50 million for communities impacted by Hurricane Helene.

MINIMUM WAGE
* $15 minimum wage by 2027.

OTHER ITEMS
* Focused on policies affecting schools, public safety and consumer protection.
* More control for local school boards over the use of cell phones in classrooms
* Passed legislation to help Appalachian Power customers with rising costs.
* almost half of the approved bills received unanimous support
* uncertainty over potential federal job cuts in Virginia

FLOOD RECOVERY FUNDING $100 million in flood recovery funding, including $50 million for communities impacted by Hurricane Helene. MINIMUM WAGE $15 minimum wage by 2027. OTHER ITEMS Focused on policies affecting schools, public safety and consumer protection.
