Taking from the poor and giving to the rich.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1528%2E791427%2ED-D39w)

[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb25.YmER0g&refcode=em250225-1-120&t=2&akid=1528%2E791427%2ED-D39w)
Team, Bernie Sanders is right.
Oligarchy has taken hold of our politics — that is, a political system where all power is in the hands of a small group of extremely wealthy individuals.
Just think back to Trump’s inauguration. Who did he have standing behind him as he took office? Not working class Americans.
It was Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, and Jeff Bezos. Three of the richest men in human history. Three men with much to gain from Trump’s policies. Three men who contributed millions and millions of dollars to Donald Trump’s campaign and inauguration.
And look at DOGE. The stated goal was to find ‘waste, fraud, and abuse’ in government spending. That’s something everyone can get behind in theory.
But in practice, DOGE is firing thousands of working class federal employees and slashing programs that benefit the most vulnerable Americans, all while protecting federal contracts that go to Elon Musk and his billionaire buddies.
**The goal of the oligarchy forming in America today is to loot our nation’s pocketbook so they can amass even more wealth and power.**
Republicans in Congress are already working to push through a new tax plan that would lower taxes for the super wealthy and corporations. And they’ve made it clear that they are willing to push cuts to Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security to pay for these tax cuts.
Literally taking from the poor and giving to the rich.
**[If we are to take on the Oligarchs in this country, we have to build the political power of the working class. That means standing together in a grassroots movement to defeat the far-right and their billionaire allies. If you’re with me, chip in just $3 today and power our work to fight Trump and Elon:**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb25.YmER0g&refcode=em250225-1-120&t=3&akid=1528%2E791427%2ED-D39w)

That’s more than North Carolina (10.8 million), Michigan (10 million), New Jersey (9.2 million), or Virginia (8.7 million).You get the picture. That’s why urgent action is needed to pass a Constitutional Amendment to ban illegal aliens from voting and from being counted for purposes of congressional and electoral vote apportionment. I’m the chairwoman of AMAC Action. **AMAC Action is the most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative Seniors.****We’ve got 72 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates, who are the “feet on the street” advocates who contact Members of Congress and state legislators in their district offices.** **Moreover, our chapters and delegates help organize Town Hall meetings with elected officials and candidates to enable those locally of our 2,000,000 AMAC members to meet, hear, and question them.****And you should also know that we now have more than 337,000 AMAC members who respond to our “calls-to-action” and weigh in with members of the** **U.S. House and Senate, as well as their state legislators on the issues.** Quite simply, when we speak, Washington listens. Snowpack is vital to the giant sequoia range because it acts as a natural reservoir, providing a steady water supply during dry months, delaying fire season, and supporting the surrounding ecosystem. Reduced snowpack due to climate change increases drought stress, wildfire risk, and threats to these ancient trees.

clean_body: News and stories from Save the Redwoods League | February 25, 2025 | Mind the gap A long-awaited opportunity to protect 1,517 acres of future parkland near the Russian River is here! The Monte Rio Redwoods Expansion is the missing link needed to connect 34 square miles of redwood forest and salmon-bearing streams—a chance to conserve wildlife habitat and grow outdoor access for all. The nature cure Grief, loss, trauma, disaster—the burdens of our modern world can be difficult to bear. League president Sam Hodder shares how time in a resilient redwood forest can help transform personal pain and reveal a path forward. Slime time It's time to celebrate this beloved, bright-yellow resident of the redwoods, recently crowned California's official state slug. Discover 10 fascinating facts about the golden gastropod, from its rappelling skills to its surprising role in medical research. Bright futures Our picks are in: 18 incredible schools, nonprofits, and community orgs that will receive a 2025 Redwood Connect Grant. Together, they’ll bring more than 3,000 youth to the redwoods for world-expanding experiences. Restoration Griff Griffith dishes on "pseudo forests"—overcrowded stands of spindly trees that arise after a redwood forest is clearcut—and shows how we can turn these stunted groves into mighty, biodiverse old growth once more. | | Instagram Post of the Month ---|--- | | ---|--- 🌲Mariposa Grove of Giant Sequoias in Yosemite National Park, covered in a light blanket of snow.❄ (🏠 Cozy winter cabin for scale.) Snowpack is vital to the giant sequoia range because it acts as a natural reservoir, providing a steady water supply during dry months, delaying fire season, and supporting the surrounding ecosystem. Reduced snowpack due to climate change increases drought stress, wildfire risk, and threats to these ancient trees. 📷 @ Adam Kaplan, Save the Redwoods League staff. Derek,
I hope you’re well. I’m reaching out again with an urgent call to action. As your State Representative and Chairman of Granite Solutions, I’ve seen firsthand the power of principled leadership at the local level.

These massive cuts to Medicaid would have drastic impacts, including: ❌ Fewer healthcare services for children, seniors, and disabled people ❌ Direct care workers losing their jobs ❌ Devastating consequences for families and communities If we take action together, Congress can’t ignore us. In solidarity, Care in Action

Peter Willis,

Tonight, Congress is holding a vote on Trump and Musk’s disastrous budget
resolution, so we need to act fast.

If passed, it would strip over $1 trillion in funding for programs like
Medicaid, SNAP, and more — all to fund tax breaks for billionaires.

But if we succeed in blocking this budget, it would be a HUMILIATING
defeat for the Trump/Musk administration.

We have a narrow window to flip vulnerable Republicans from blue districts
before the vote tonight. That’s why our Citizen Action Team is on the
ground in DC, applying as much pressure as they can. But we need a proper
grassroots movement to stand up and say NO to oligarchy. Will you fight
alongside us?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21771?t=1011&akid=7755%2E5885482%2EX-VIwN ]Sign our petition to Congress, demanding that this cash-grab budget
proposal be REJECTED. Taking away Medicaid funding to enrich billionaires
is outrageous.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21771?t=1012&akid=7755%2E5885482%2EX-VIwN ]ADD YOUR NAME

opposition is gaining momentum.

On Friday, Bernie kicked off his “Fighting Oligarchy" nationwide tour in
Omaha, to pressure Reps Don Bacon (R-NE) and Mariannette Miller-Meeks
(R-IA) out of supporting the GOP’s proposed cuts.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21771?t=1013&akid=7755%2E5885482%2EX-VIwN ][IMG]

together, sent an unmistakable message to Congress: “If you betray the
working class on behalf of billionaires like Elon Musk, and come for our
Medicaid, Medicare, or Social Security, good luck winning re-election.”

Defeating Trump, Musk, and the Oligarchy will not happen because of
flowery press conferences or passionate speeches in the Senate. It’ll be
won by millions of people, in every state in America, refusing to accept
an even further descent into authoritarianism.

Team: Our voices need to be loud and strong as we demand that Congress act to preserve birthright citizenship >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/sign-defend-birthright-citizenship-and-our-constitution-stop-hr-569?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project]

Voter Action Project
Folks,
On his first day in office, President Donald Trump issued an executive order ending birthright citizenship , an order that a Reagan-appointed judge called “ blatantly unconstitutional .” Now, dozens in the House of Representatives are co-sponsoring H.R. 569, which would also deny citizenship to children of non-citizens.
Birthright citizenship has been the law of the land since the Supreme Court ruled in US v. Wong Kim Ark that the Constitution granted citizenship to American-born children without a citizen parent.
Ending automatic citizenship for people born in the United States is the beginning of a slippery slope where citizenship and our rights could be denied to any of us. It's too dangerous to even contemplate further.
We all have to stand up right now and tell Congress: NO to ANY changes in birthright citizenship! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/sign-defend-birthright-citizenship-and-our-constitution-stop-hr-569?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project]

name: George Whitesides
subject: What I know more than most
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gw-q1-2025?refcode=em-header [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gw-q1-2025?refcode=em-header]
Peter,

Back in 2009, I was chosen by President Obama to serve as the NASA Chief of Staff. It was a true honor.

At NASA, people of all stripes put aside self-interest and political differences to move the country forward together. I know more than most: NASA's ability to conduct exploration and science is dependent on its people.

That’s what makes the recent blows to NASA from the White House so devastating.

As you know, the Trump-Musk agenda is wreaking havoc on our institutions with attacks that become more infuriating by the day. Thousands of federal workers have been impacted, and just recently, these terminations and personnel actions have hit employees at NASA, weather forecasters at the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), and more.

Make no mistake: These decisions make our country and our democracy weaker.

Indiscriminately firing the next generation of NASA scientists, engineers and wider team members is exactly the wrong step to secure America's leadership in space. I’m leveraging my position on the Science, Space & Technology Committee in Congress to fight against these setbacks.

I hope to have your continued support in this effort and in keeping CA-27 blue. This seat is already a top GOP target, and losing here would squash our hopes of a Democratic majority to hold this administration accountable.

Thank you,

George

On February 24th, the [Times Union ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3d1ee421-2966-4c42-9673-d6e4b69b5356?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)published an article "NY hospital spending has tripled as quality declines"

New York (like every state) is about 30 years overdue for a massive health care overhaul, according to a new report as healthcare costs spiral out of control. Costs are spiraling in Connecticut.
"New York's per patient spending has risen from $14,000 in 2020 to $26,000 in 2023."
A lot of this has been due to the consolidation of our healthcare system and the disappearance of private practice. **Private Practice was critical to community care.**
**
As a Physician, Private Practices have disappeared due to the fact that:**
1. Hospital Networks (consolidated healthcare systems) have much stronger bargaining power than individual physicians and therefore get paid much more that private practitioners for the same care.
_This is a trend that has been going on for over a decade. The office of the Massachusetts Attorney General conducted a study over a decade ago that concluded that**there could be up to a 300% difference in cost for the same services based on the bargaining power of the provider.**_
2. Our regulatory state has made it increasingly difficult for private practitioners to comply with all of the increasing complex and un-necessary regulations imposed by the Federal Government.
_**Many simply give up and seek employment in hospital systems and large groups.**_

**THE PROBLEM OF CONSOLIDATION** \- 70% of our expensive emergency room visits could be replaced with more cost effective primary care visits if they were available.
**WHAT ARE THE SOLUTIONS?**
_**As D.O.G.E. looks to streamline the Federal Government, the Health solutions are simple. It starts with the ABCs**_
A. **Allow** Private practitioners to bargain collectively and get higher fees.
* This can be accomplished by State and/or Federal Law.

It sounds counterintuitive to pay doctors more to lower healthcare costs.
* A 25% increase in private practice fees would have a major impact on their income and still allow them to provide care at costs that are significantly lower than hospital systems.
* Private practitioners are more accessible to their patients and many patients with semi-urgent conditions would shift from Emergency Room care to the private office if given the opportunity. This was the premise behind the Urgent Care facilities, but those have mostly become part of the Hospital Networks and do not reduce the emergency room.

B. **Broaden** Availability of Primary Care Physicians
* **No income tax on Physician Overtime**. President Trump is proposing legislation that would allow workers who work overtime to earn their overtime income tax free. _**If we allowed doctors and other healthcare professionals to have the same benefit of tax free income when they work overtime treating patients we would have more access to primary care and other physicians without increasing healthcare costs.**_****
* We need to incentivize primary care physicians to extend their hours. Doctors, unlike others employed in private practice of medicine (like Admins, Technicians, RNs, LPNs, Nursing Assistants) do not get time and a half or overtime for working additional hours.
_**Longer hours without incentives is not happening and cost of care increases for the staff without a commensurate offset for physicians.**_
* Providing medical care is grueling and burnout is high and with the current state of medicine, many younger healthcare workers are likely to exit healthcare.
* This change would not change insurance re-imbursement as insurance companies and the government would pay the same fees for service, but by making it tax free the doctor would increase their take home pay.
_**Without the incentive to work overtime doctors would stay home so there would be almost no loss of income tax revenue with this plan.**_
* If Every patient was given that option, they would prefer to go to someone they know over a cold, impersonal and inefficient Emergency Room.
* This would save over $1,000 per visit in Connecticut.
_**The current average emergency Room visit in Connecticut is $1,633 and the average cost in the NYC Metro Area is $3,556.30.**_
* Many of these services could be provided in private offices for less than 20% of what it would costs to provide them in an Emergency Room.

C. **Conserve** **Medicaid**(**Husky in CT)**. The final extra cost to our healthcare system is the availability of free Medicaid for Illegal Aliens while businesses, middle class people and self employed struggle with increasingly higher healthcare costs.
* By law, any ER has to take patients and take care of patients in the ER.
_**No one is advocating denying care for ERs, but there needs to be a reduction in full medical benefits for illegal aliens to have better care than most private payers that struggle with deductibles that are several thousand dollars and even higher for families.**_

D. **De-Regulate Administrative Paperwork** \- Physicians spend **20+** hours a week complying with healthcare paperwork which provides little to no benefit to healthcare outcomes. Your sexual history and gender are not relevant when you walk into an ER with a broken arm.
_**The patient intake form which was 3 pages when I worked in an ER is now 50 pages or more. 47 plus extra pages does NOT improve outcomes - it reduces outcomes as fatigue from paperwork and administration results in a healthcare team that may not be focused on your care but compliance with bureaucracy.**_

As a Congressional Candidate in 2024 I advocated on a platform for a more cost effective healthcare system with more competition and less regulation.
_**Team Goldstein knocked doors this weekend for a Special State Senate Race for Connecticut 's 21st District for Jason Perillo.**_
_**Healthcare and Immigration are major topics for Connecticut voters that we talked to and we knocked on doors of unaffiliated voters. There is a justified resentment of private sector workers paying for healthcare and watching the illegal aliens with carte blanche health care on Husky. They would not trade their lives for those on welfare or other public assistance, but seek equality of healthcare not subsidizing their own health for worse coverage than those who do not contribute to our system.
**_
We are still fighting for lower healthcare costs and better quality healthcare.
I am asking for your support to help in make this happen.

_The father-son team continues on_ so please spread the word and lets really rebuild CT together in a meaningful way.

\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: **Rashida Tlaib******
Date: Mon, Feb 24, 2025
Subject: Tell Congress to reject cuts to education, healthcare, and nutrition to pay for tax cuts for the rich
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com

Friend,
Tomorrow, House Republicans are planning a vote on a budget that rips life-saving services away from our communities to pay for more tax cuts for their millionaire and billionaire donors.
**This right-wing budget includes $330 billion in cuts to education―impacting Head Start, school meals, student loans, Pell Grants, HBCUs, and more.** Head Start serves more than 800,000 children across the country, supporting early childhood learning, development, and health.
Already, the Trump administration’s federal funding freeze has resulted in several Head Start programs shutting down, with more at risk: 57 programs serving 21,000 children said they can’t access federal funding. I led my colleagues in the Congressional Mamas’ Caucus in sending a letter to Trump demanding the immediate restoration of Head Start funding, and together we must also fight back against these Congress-proposed attacks on public education.
**House Republicans' proposed budget also includes $230 billion in cuts to nutrition assistance.** While the details are still forthcoming, this will likely include reducing daily SNAP nutrition benefits from $6.20 to just $4.80, drastically limiting beneficiaries’ nutrition benefits if they can’t document a certain number of hours of work or show they’re exempt, or forcing states to cut benefits and implement waiting lists.
**On healthcare, Republicans want to cut $880 billion from Medicaid** , essentially defunding the whole program. name: Tim Kaine
subject: Updates on action from Dems →
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
Derek, I want to update you on the actions Democrats are taking to fight back against the lawless Trump Administration and un-elected billionaire Elon Musk — and share how you can help.
Our strategy to take on Trump and Musk and save our democracy has five parts: Courts, Congress, States, Elections, and Activism.
Here’s the latest news on all fronts:
Courts
As of last week, 29 judicial rulings have ordered at least temporary halts to Trump Administration initiatives, thanks to a well-coordinated court strategy that began on Inauguration Day.
* The Musk-driven effort to gut USAID is at least partly on hold;
* As is an order to cut funding on scientific research at the National Institutes of Health.
* There is also pending legal action challenging the freeze on foreign aid, civil servant firings, the federal funding freeze, the powers of DOGE, immigration policies, and more.
We won’t win all of these cases — and some could reach the Supreme Court sooner rather than later — but partners and allies all across the country are seeing positive results already.
Congress
It’s true that with Democrats in the minority in both the Senate and the House, the actions available to us are limited — but that doesn’t mean we’re standing idly by. I’m using every single legislative tool at my disposal to challenge Trump’s disastrous plans, and I’ll continue to do so as long as it takes to get results.
Right now, our top priority is fighting the GOP budget, which is a clear blueprint to enact the dangerous Project 2025 agenda, including plans for $4.5 trillion in tax cuts to the wealthy at the expense of critical programs like Medicaid, Medicare, and Head Start.
States
Dozens of state attorneys general have already taken action on the legal front to protect their states from Trump’s dangerous orders, and Democratic governors and state officials are doing everything they can to put protections in place and sound the alarm about the negative impacts of this Administration on people’s everyday lives. Local elected officials will continue to play a key role in preventing the implementation of Trump’s illegal orders.
Elections
Already this year, Democrats are seeing victories in special elections across the country — a bellwether for future wins here in Virginia this November and in the midterms next year. We’re winning in Iowa, New York, Minnesota, Virginia, and even Oklahoma, and are fighting hard for wins in upcoming elections in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin.
My sights are squarely set on Virginia’s major elections this November — and I sincerely hope you’ll take action and get involved. Historically, Virginia’s gubernatorial elections have served as a major opportunity for Democrats to push back and make a strong statement of our electoral intentions, and this year is no different. If you can, consider chipping in now to my Common Ground PAC, which will be laser-focused on supporting our great VA Democrats on the ballot this November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
Activism
Peaceful public activism is a critical part of the opposition to this lawless Trump Administration, and that’s where I need your help now more than ever. Take action with groups who are fighting back like Indivisible [https://indivisible.org/take-action-now] , ACLU [https://www.aclu.org/] , NAACP [https://naacp.org/take-action] , Planned Parenthood [https://www.plannedparenthoodaction.org/] , and Human Rights Campaign [https://www.hrc.org/get-involved] — or hit the phones directly and call your representatives in the Capitol at (202) 224-3121.
A really important part of this pushback is making sure the GOP hears loud and clear how the public feels about their deference to Trump’s lawlessness — so please, help us expand our reach in challenging areas by reaching out to congressional Republicans.
I know this political environment is challenging — it’s exhausting, confusing, and disheartening. But I promise you three things:
1. Fighting back is worth it.
2. I’m right by your side in this, every day.
3. We won’t stop until we win.
Thanks for reading and for your continued dedication to our democracy and our country’s founding values.
More to come,
Tim Kaine

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Getting fired is bad enough
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I know how important a job can be and how hard it is when you lose one.
#

Peter, it’s Ruben.
I grew up poor. That’s no secret. I know how important a job can be and how hard it is when you lose one.
I’m a veteran, too. A lot of my friends were killed and wounded. I know what it means to sacrifice for your country.
And, I depend on the VA. I came home and had to fight for care for myself and the guys I fought with. The VA is the largest health care provider in the United States, and we have a duty to make sure it meets veterans' needs.
Elon Musk and Donald Trump started firing thousands of public servants alongside 1000 VA staff last week and another 1400 VA staff yesterday. To put it bluntly, this is bullsh*t.
First off, it’s bad enough that these people are getting fired. Getting fired sucks. It’s one of the worst things that can happen to you.
But these people — many of them veterans themselves, many of them in service for decades, who joined the government to serve the public — are apparently getting fired by Elon’s DOGE stooges and their algorithms. At this point, Trump and Elon have fired more veterans than any organization in history.
They’re out to break everything the government does so they can privatize the VA and destroy Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security. The rich get richer while everything gets more expensive for the rest of us.
That’s the play. That’s their move. And they’re pressing ahead.
Republicans in the House and Senate are working through their funding bills right now. They’re teeing up more massive cuts to critical government services, thousands more veterans fired, and trillions more in tax cuts for the wealthiest people on earth.
**But we do not have to sit here and take it.**
I am going to do whatever I can to stop them, but here’s the truth: I can’t do it on my own.
I came to the Senate to fight, and that’s what I’m going to do. But I need you with me if we’re going to make a difference.
So, if you can, please: [**Make a donation to my campaign and help us keep the fight up against Trump and Elon. It’d mean a lot.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-feb25.RCmV-L&refcode=em250225-1-120&t=1&akid=3732%2E734936%2EM9arvl)

body:
I’m so glad you’re here. Life has a way of throwing us curveballs, doesn’t it? But if there’s one thing I’ve learned, it’s that we’re all writing the next chapter of our own story—every single day. | | | [](http://links.meganbarry.com/s/c/y1KmRF59m9-dkGTgOfgpAgi2icgGvZjoZuamOe2hEFJXaxDtd_1xfuIGFFzKS1M2JLj51k64YGydUHPaOE2BzclcY1NOoPHJ__vah3C9WsCRbrVbf30W2yXP3LLzcfE-01GK5aZ-uKIteAZpgz7_-QeuGvYyY3RZtnnOfvFYAyD6dutt2QmKh-4raKHRmi3tmddbJntbk3dQVthAo0RKOcevcqtaUE84TkuFWn0NcIJm5tnpqFBnlApqqZNGQf1wjONZWVI-Ksvorkg066E7JaSTYwAy/W2y1TXfhuGafdU3LPY09r6-rU2ufANdV/6) **Welcome to the first edition of It’s What YOU Do Next: Your Next Chapter Newsletter!** I’m so glad you’re here. Life has a way of throwing us curveballs, doesn’t it? But if there’s one thing I’ve learned, it’s that we’re all writing the next chapter of our own story—every single day. For me, this chapter is all about leaning into the lessons I’ve learned, taking life as it comes, and staying hopeful for whatever’s around the corner. Maybe you’ve read my book (thank you!), heard me speak, cheered me on in the past, or just happened to stumble across this newsletter—whatever brought you here, I’m grateful. My hope is that this newsletter becomes a little space we can share each month—a check-in where we talk about the things that matter, the challenges we face, and the wins (big or small) we get to celebrate. Peter, Look, I know there’s a lot of concerning news right now, and it’s easy to feel disheartened and worried for the future. But we can’t give up or lose hope. **Donald Trump and Elon Musk are losing in court... _a lot._** Trump’s Executive Order ending Birthright Citizenship and OMB Federal Funding Freeze are both facing Preliminary Injunctions by multiple District Courts. And Trump’s Federal Employee “Buyout”, purge of FBI agents, dismantling of USAID, and DOGE’s access to taxpayer data have all been issued Temporary Restraining Orders by the courts. **We’re going to do everything we can to fight back against these outrageous abuses of power – in Congress, in the courts, and at the ballot box.** I’m not the type to back down from a tough fight and I'm continuing to do everything possible to push back on this Administration and its unlawful actions, but Peter, I need you by my side every step of the way. Friend,
We’re just two weeks away from the special election that will determine control of the Minnesota House. There’s a lot at stake here. If we don’t win this seat, Republicans will be in charge for two whole years. They’re already trying to move forward legislation that would roll back paid family medical leave, restrict reproductive freedom, cut funding for public schools, and so much more.
If you want a different future for Minnesota, I need to ask you to donate today. My campaign and our House DFL team are working hard to make sure we can deliver for Minnesota, but we need your help. | | Fellow Conservative, Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_. But today, all that has changed. The president of the American Library Association (ALA) is a self-described “Marxist lesbian.” Radical librarians call _Adventure of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic” _Little House_ series. And they bring men in wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for...”
---
| | [](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss9c50&__onlt=h)
---
| Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.”

| | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating “the environment” to a type of religion. The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse. But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.” That may be good for your family – for now. But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! **[**I hope you see why I need your help today to TAKE BACK OUR LIBRARIES.**](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss9c50&__onlt=h)** My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.” I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood. But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian. When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named **Brave Books** , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit. And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own. Our idea was to read the classic books you and I grew up with plus new wholesome Brave Books that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism. And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected our request to host our Story Hour. >> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep us out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), Brave Books was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” our supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end we got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States. And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those Story Hours where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America,” and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part... From there, parents and grandparents started asking Brave Books how they could host Story Hours of their own. So Brave Books has organized a nationwide grassroots “See You at the Library” movement to take back our libraries. Now with the guidance of Brave Books, committed conservatives just like you book event rooms at their local library for conservative Story Hours that fill children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God. And whenever we can, Brave Books authors like swimmer Riley Gaines, TV personality Missy Robertson, and myself stand shoulder-to-shoulder with conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots at these Story Hours... ...for a very simple mission – to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. And our ambitious goal is to expand our “See You at the Library” movement to reach over 100,000 children in the next year. Which is why we need you! **[_I hope you’ll be able to give a sponsorship gift of $35, $50, $75, $100, $150 or more today._..](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss9c50&__onlt=h)** Your sponsorship gift will be used to send a “Story Hour Kit” to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing an event at their library. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for the little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Brave Books is a small Christian company. They don’t have the millions behind them like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our Story Hours for over 100,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. Knowing that, **_[_please consider a sponsorship gift of $175._](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss9c50&__onlt=h)_** That’s enough to sponsor one entire “Story Hour Kit” yourself. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. **_[Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $175, or anything higher or lower will be necessary for the success of the next “Story Hour Kit” to be sent.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss9c50&__onlt=h)_**
---
[**DONATE**](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss9c50&__onlt=h)
---
Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America,

body:
I hate to break it to you our Republican House Majority is NOT safe. The Democrats came dangerously close to retaking the House Majority in 2024. | Fellow Conservative,

I hate to break it to you our _Republican House Majority is NOT safe_. The Democrats came dangerously close to retaking the House Majority in 2024. Now they’re preparing an unprecedented campaign to retake the final couple of seats they need to reclaim the Majority.

Friend – the poster you see here has popped up all over our nation's capital. It's outside the Treasury Department, where Musk and his band of acolytes have attempted to gain control over the federal government's payment system.

It's outside USAID, a government agency that Musk has unlawfully tried to abolish.

And it's all over Capitol Hill, where a cowardly acquiescence from Republican majorities in Congress has enabled Elon Musk to ransack our federal government freely.
**Friend, these posters are not hyperbole. Elon Musk – an unelected billionaire without security clearance to whom Donald Trump has granted unchecked power and access – is stealing from us. Elon Musk is stealing our privacy, he is stealing our jobs, he is stealing our information and data, and most importantly, he is stealing our future.**
For while Trump's largest campaign donor has such immense power at his fingertips – power that he can use to enrich himself and quash anything not to his liking – the future of our nation and its people rests on dangerously shaky ground.
The good news is that the people are fighting back. Record numbers of constituents are showing up to Republican congressional representative town halls to voice their outrage. These same offices are receiving record numbers of calls from rightly angry constituents. We must keep up the pressure and show, by and large, that the American people will not allow Musk and Trump to rule through antidemocratic, illegal actions.

I'm doing everything I can to stop Musk's takeover of our democracy, and I urge you to do the same. Please, keep up the fight.

Thank you,

Dick

name: Doug Lindner, LCV
subject: [ACT TODAY]: Help protect democracy against threats to voting rights and election integrity
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTIxNjkxMjgS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjE2MDM4NTUxOAS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
TELL CONGRESS TO PROTECT VOTING RIGHTS AND ELECTION INTEGRITY

A bill that is moving rapidly through Congress, the SAVE Act, is threatening to
undermine the integrity of our nation’s democracy. This bill disenfranchises
millions of eligible voters by imposing draconian barriers to voter
registration.

The House could vote on this bill within the next few days — and we have a real
chance to prevent it from becoming law. But we need your help: Send a message to your members of Congress today urging them to vote NO on the SAVE Act. Help us reach our 5,000 signature goal >> https://links.messages.lcv. TAKE ACTION NOW >> https://links.messages.lcv. Hi Peter, The Republican-led Congress is wasting no time in working to undermine our
democracy. A bill called the SAVE Act is rapidly moving towards a vote on the
floors of the House and Senate, and it is a major attack on voting rights,
election integrity, and trust in our voting system. The SAVE Act would disenfranchise millions of eligible votersby requiring hugely restrictive voter ID requirements, which disproportionately
impact marginalized communities, including seniors, students, people of color,
and women. It would effectively ban voter registration drives, online voter
registration, and voter registration by mail. By requiring registering voters to register in person and show documents proving
their citizenship, this bill would make registration harder for the more than
146 million estimated Americans who don’t have a valid U.S. passport, the 69
million estimated married women whose current names don’t match their birth
certificate names, and the millions of people from the LGBTQ+ community whose
name or genders don’t match up with what’s on their passports or birth
certificates. The SAVE Act is a voter suppression bill that only pretends to address a real
problem. States already have secure systems in place to verify eligibility and
prevent noncitizens from voting. There are already state and federal laws
imposing severe penalties for voting by people who aren’t eligible. There is no
widespread voter fraud in America, but anti-democracy politicians want to make
voting harder anyway. Our movement can stop them — but we need your voice to speak out against this harmful federal legislation
that threatens voting rights and election integrity. Tell your members of Congress: Vote NO on the extreme anti-voter SAVE Act. Help LCV reach 5,000 signatures demanding that Congress protect our right to vote in free and fair elections >> https://links.messages.lcv. TAKE ACTION >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_ The right to vote is the foundation of our democracy and our nation’s most
cherished freedom. It is foundational to protecting clean air and clean water,
fighting for a sustainable future, securing environmental justice, protecting
public lands, and curbing health-harming pollution. There can be no healthy environment without a healthy democracy.This legislation weakens the political power of everyday people and could block
progress on the critical issues that affect our communities and our planet by
making it harder for millions of Americans to vote. You can help stop these harmful measures. Take action today: It only takes a moment to tell Congress to protect our voting rights >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/- Thank you for your commitment to protecting our democracy! Onward, Doug Lindner
Senior Director of Judiciary & Democracy
League of Conservation Voters This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. * **TOP NEWS**

"**Border crossing numbers in Texas plummet as 'reverse flow' begins,** " Houston Chronicle's**Matt deGrood** -- "President **Donald Trump** has been in office for just over a month and his mark on federal government is already everywhere.

But one of the biggest impacts so far has been his [crackdown on the border](https://substack.com/redirect/ee0f182f-f67f-4b4f-b139-fb2b9c5cdc78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), specifically**** in**** Texas.

In January, U.S. Immigration and Customs reported just 16,553 encounters with people crossing along all five border patrol sectors within Texas. That amounts to a 63% drop from just a year ago and a nearly 80% drop from two years ago.

In the Del Rio sector, which includes Eagle Pass, the number was down to just 3,500 encounters for January. Compare that to just over a year ago, when 71,000 encounters were reported.

Eagle Pass became the center of the national debate over border security over the last two years as the [number of migrants from Venezuela, Cuba and Haiti skyrocketed during Biden's administration](https://substack.com/redirect/f9b52408-26de-4bf8-9190-b4d0ee03c3ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It was in Eagle Pass, that Gov. **Greg Abbott** first began deploying razor wire and a floating bouy barrier in the Rio Grande to block people from crossing, and Republican presidential candidates, including Trump, all flocked to the region to call attention to it all.

To be sure, the border crossing numbers had been on steady decline for the last six months as former President **Joe Biden** implemented programs to slow border crossing and got Mexican officials to step up their efforts to slow crossings**.**

The downward trend has only aided Trump as he looks to make border security his signature issue. In starting his second term, he has promised to get border wall construction restarted, ended the online asylum appointment app created by Biden, pressured Mexico to stop migrants from getting to the border and is now reportedly looking to re-instate a COVID-19 era policy~~~~ that would allow U.S. immigration officials to swiftly expel people on the grounds of preventing the spread of disease.

Taken altogether, it now has asylum seekers who braved trekking through the jungles of the Darien Gap on the Colombia-Panama border, trying to go back to the countries they once left. The Associated Press reported on the ["reverse flow" of migrants](https://substack.com/redirect/3c980a65-01dd-4784-abc4-a05f46866f86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who are now boarding small speed boats to get back to South America.

**Karla Castillo** , a 36-year-old Venezuelan making the return journey with her younger sister, said with Trump's actions "all our hopes went up in smoke."

And that is before the mass deportation program that is aiming to round up people who already had crossed the border. On Monday, [federal immigration officials descended on Colony Ridge](https://substack.com/redirect/3f73247d-066d-414e-9661-098a2797ff6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a sprawling development northeast of Harris County that has long been the subject of right-wing conspiracy theories, for what appeared to be the first major Houston-area deportation crackdown under Trump.

Trump's border czar **Tom Homan** , told the Houston Chronicle in an interview that he was present for the operation, which was ongoing as of Monday afternoon." TOP NEWS "Border crossing numbers in Texas plummet as 'reverse flow' begins, " Houston Chronicle'sMatt deGrood -- "President Donald Trump has been in office for just over a month and his mark on federal government is already everywhere. But one of the biggest impacts so far has been his , specifically** in Texas. In January, U.S. Immigration and Customs reported just 16,553 encounters with people crossing along all five border patrol sectors within Texas. That amounts to a 63% drop from just a year ago and a nearly 80% drop from two years ago. In the Del Rio sector, which includes Eagle Pass, the number was down to just 3,500 encounters for January. Compare that to just over a year ago, when 71,000 encounters were reported. Eagle Pass became the center of the national debate over border security over the last two years as the . It was in Eagle Pass, that Gov. Greg Abbott first began deploying razor wire and a floating bouy barrier in the Rio Grande to block people from crossing, and Republican presidential candidates, including Trump, all flocked to the region to call attention to it all. To be sure, the border crossing numbers had been on steady decline for the last six months as former President Joe Biden implemented programs to slow border crossing and got Mexican officials to step up their efforts to slow crossings. The downward trend has only aided Trump as he looks to make border security his signature issue. In starting his second term, he has promised to get border wall construction restarted, ended the online asylum appointment app created by Biden, pressured Mexico to stop migrants from getting to the border and is now reportedly looking to re-instate a COVID-19 era policy~~~~ that would allow U.S. immigration officials to swiftly expel people on the grounds of preventing the spread of disease. Taken altogether, it now has asylum seekers who braved trekking through the jungles of the Darien Gap on the Colombia-Panama border, trying to go back to the countries they once left. The Associated Press reported on the who are now boarding small speed boats to get back to South America. Karla Castillo , a 36-year-old Venezuelan making the return journey with her younger sister, said with Trump's actions "all our hopes went up in smoke." And that is before the mass deportation program that is aiming to round up people who already had crossed the border. On Monday, , a sprawling development northeast of Harris County that has long been the subject of right-wing conspiracy theories, for what appeared to be the first major Houston-area deportation crackdown under Trump. Trump's border czar Tom Homan , told the Houston Chronicle in an interview that he was present for the operation, which was ongoing as of Monday afternoon." Friend, During Black History Month, we celebrate the Black Marylanders who’ve led the fight for justice. From Frederick Douglass and Thurgood Marshall to the scores of unnamed civil rights activists who worked tirelessly for better schools, equal pay, and real justice — we honor them each and every day. Our mission is to make this Maryland’s decade, but _we can’t do so without learning from Maryland’s past._ Black Marylanders have been incredibly impactful leaders in all corners of our state, including:
* Mayor Kurt Schmoke, my mentor and a champion in Baltimore
* Ike Leggett, the first Black County Executive of Montgomery County
* Wayne Curry, the first Black County Executive of Prince George’s County
* Delegate Lena K. Lee, one of the first African American women elected to the MD General Assembly
* Speaker Adrienne A. Jones, the first Black and first female Speaker of the Maryland House of Delegates
* James West, a professor at Johns Hopkins University and the inventor of the electret microphone, which is used in nearly all modern microphones today

Black History Month reminds us about the importance of continually educating ourselves, not just this month, but all year. We must take the time to acknowledge the diverse experiences of Black Americans and strive to do better to reach an equitable country by building pathways to work, wages and wealth — that’s the only way to build a better future, together. Black Americans have continued to move the needle on what is and can be expected when it comes to leadership, meeting the moment, and making progress. Here’s to celebrating another year of excellence and joy. Happy Black History Month. Elevate, Wes

clean_body: Friend, During Black History Month, we celebrate the Black Marylanders who’ve led the fight for justice. From Frederick Douglass and Thurgood Marshall to the scores of unnamed civil rights activists who worked tirelessly for better schools, equal pay, and real justice — we honor them each and every day. Our mission is to make this Maryland’s decade, but we can’t do so without learning from Maryland’s past. Black Marylanders have been incredibly impactful leaders in all corners of our state, including: Mayor Kurt Schmoke, my mentor and a champion in Baltimore Ike Leggett, the first Black County Executive of Montgomery County Wayne Curry, the first Black County Executive of Prince George’s County Delegate Lena K. Lee, one of the first African American women elected to the MD General Assembly Speaker Adrienne A. Jones, the first Black and first female Speaker of the Maryland House of Delegates James West, a professor at Johns Hopkins University and the inventor of the electret microphone, which is used in nearly all modern microphones today Black History Month reminds us about the importance of continually educating ourselves, not just this month, but all year. We must take the time to acknowledge the diverse experiences of Black Americans and strive to do better to reach an equitable country by building pathways to work, wages and wealth — that’s the only way to build a better future, together. Black Americans have continued to move the needle on what is and can be expected when it comes to leadership, meeting the moment, and making progress. Here’s to celebrating another year of excellence and joy. Happy Black History Month. Elevate, Wes

[**In a moment, I’m going to ask you to split a contribution between my campaign and Jonathan Nez »**](https://clicksp.jonathannezforaz.com/f/a/tk3vmqB4J4nxhqfgfIdEWQ~~/AAPPABA~/cc6GBMbyBK1og2siwCDjvRH9O386kDOAuttlob7qeBtzLl6n2suLDIqwWEqRDXvNHCBSYHsjRxWrBJ2NnHC6WP_e2uWBxTMwZhZj7zdguzGzvIf4YaDQMeWFgRYYrgRVNgLBQhy2uNBKX4bXA6Oe7H8kKKtqSDOsA22TzHhl3JIPrwz40tLME8FoXRT-XaIo3n1Uw353tnXzerek32u4QwCidv5vRiOKzMiRNdG8KkuTntSPjv2RecPFQKDdvqgDlGjXhWbiGZq7BEanJ6R99jz_dc3JwAlVN8kpCKOFH2OirHJRCrFUg9xV_gdG29L4bcSZGQfpPCx7h2Qydlih55y-jb3VzYoRgGlK50O_F4LT_0goBdwxBHaqYgOpxe-NWHTVCjFB7-wYDloGtN-roVz3A1MT9V_CfgYYanKGWRhEronNfykEt6JYO9_ZBUwmmRoaeqa9Wmut5PpfJOUclimLaXeFDIT-cIk1QBTqjd4~) But first, I want to outline for you the threats we’re facing and what Jonathan Nez and I are doing to fight back. Donald Trump and Elon Musk have gone after funding for education and cancer research, taken a _sledgehammer_ to the EPA, and eliminated domestic watchdogs like the CFPB that stop banks from ripping off consumers. It’s hard to imagine Medicare, Social Security, and Medicaid won’t be next on their list. Americans are scared – _and rightfully so._ That’s why I introduced the “Nobody Elected Elon Musk Act” – to hold Elon accountable for his attacks on our federal government. This move could put our election security at serious risk. We only need two seats to flip the House. And because Donald Trump won my district, national Republicans smell blood in the water and think they can take me out. Your early donation is more than just a show of support — it's a strategic investment that allows us to lay the groundwork for success. I know it can sometimes feel unclear how your contribution translates into real progress, so let me break it down. In these first crucial months, your support helps us:
* **Secure essential campaign infrastructure** — from office space to technology that powers our voter outreach.

name: Tobias Read
subject: Updates from the Secretary of State’s Office 📸
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250225em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250225em]
Hi folks, it’s Oregon Secretary of State Tobias Read.
We may be just a few months into 2025, but my team is already hard at work for the people of Oregon. Take a look at what we’ve been up to recently:
Last week, I testified before the Rules Committee to emphasize my office’s commitment to integrity, accountability, and competence across all our work . You can watch that testimony here [https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/mediaplayer/?clientID=4879615486&eventID=2025021148] at the 41:25 marker.
https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/mediaplayer/?clientID=4879615486&eventID=2025021148 [https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/mediaplayer/?clientID=4879615486&eventID=2025021148]
I also took the first steps toward meeting my goal of visiting all 36 county clerks during my first year as Secretary of State. I visited Linn County ( home of vote-by-mail in Oregon [https://www.oregonlive.com/opinion/2018/09/opinion_rememberingoregons_tru.html] ) and Benton County ( which has Oregon's only county-wide ranked-choice voting system [https://re.bentoncountyor.gov/ranked-choice-voting/] ).
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250225em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250225em]
During my visits, I was reminded that the Secretary of State needs to be a strong partner to our county clerks and the nonpartisan officials who conduct Oregon’s elections.
But our county elections offices face serious challenges — including rapid changes in technology [https://electionlab.mit.edu/research/voting-technology] , threats to public safety [https://www.klcc.org/politics-government/2023-11-09/fbi-investigating-election-threats-in-oregon] , vandalism of ballot boxes [https://www.opb.org/article/2024/10/28/ballot-box-burned-portland-vancouver/] , and staffing shortages that we need to address.
So over the next year, I will continue to listen to clerks and their staff. I won’t shy away from the critical work of fighting for Oregonians.
Thanks for reading my newsletter and staying up to date on what my office is doing for you in Salem and across the state. I am grateful to have you on the team!
Thanks,
Tobias
P.S. If you’d like to chip in to support my campaign and our work to strengthen and defend democracy, please donate here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250225em]

clean_body: [] Hi folks, it’s Oregon Secretary of State Tobias Read. We may be just a few months into 2025, but my team is already hard at work for the people of Oregon. Take a look at what we’ve been up to recently: Last week, I testified before the Rules Committee to emphasize my office’s commitment to integrity, accountability, and competence across all our work . You can watch that testimony here [] at the 41:25 marker. [] I also took the first steps toward meeting my goal of visiting all 36 county clerks during my first year as Secretary of State. I visited Linn County ( home of vote-by-mail in Oregon [] ) and Benton County ( which has Oregon's only county-wide ranked-choice voting system [] ). [] During my visits, I was reminded that the Secretary of State needs to be a strong partner to our county clerks and the nonpartisan officials who conduct Oregon’s elections. But our county elections offices face serious challenges — including rapid changes in technology [] , threats to public safety [] , vandalism of ballot boxes [] , and staffing shortages that we need to address. So over the next year, I will continue to listen to clerks and their staff. I won’t shy away from the critical work of fighting for Oregonians. Thanks for reading my newsletter and staying up to date on what my office is doing for you in Salem and across the state. I am grateful to have you on the team! Thanks, Tobias P.S. If you’d like to chip in to support my campaign and our work to strengthen and defend democracy, please donate here. For decades, the United States has been the cornerstone of global democracy, a steadfast ally to Europe, and a leader in international security. But under Donald Trump’s leadership, that reputation is crumbling.
Following Germany’s recent elections, Friedrich Merz, the leader of the Christian Democrats, made a shocking statement: Europe must begin distancing itself from the U.S. because the Trump administration “mostly doesn’t care” about Europe’s fate. He also compared Trump’s interference in German elections—through endorsements by Vice President JD Vance and Elon Musk—to the influence operations we’ve seen from Moscow.
Help me keep the U.S. at the pinnacle of diplomacy and leadership.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/2F535947507A394D424574565639786A776A317041424647325A6C35716C635A6A5A325963426238364A3643467765583130705372376B585A36437930486343/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-02-25%20at%2011.51.21%E2%80%AFAM.png]

Our standing in the world matters. When we abandon our allies, we weaken democracy everywhere. We must fight to restore America’s credibility, strengthen NATO, and ensure that the U.S. remains a trusted leader on the world stage. We cannot afford to turn our backs on our allies.

| | **“****A disproportionate number of illegal immigrants go to blue states, they amplify the effect of a blue state vote. My understanding is that Democrats would lose approximately 20 seats in the house if illegals were not counted in census. And that’s also 20 less electoral votes for president.**** ** **So, illegals absolutely do impact who controls the House and the presidency.”****~** Elon Musk
---
| | Fellow Conservative,Elon Musk is right. It isn’t rocket-science. It’s basic math. It’s also a ticking time-bomb set by Joe Biden and Kamala Harris – in the form of 11.5 million illegals entering our country on their watch – one which will explode shortly after President Trump leaves office in 2029.While you and I have no doubt President Trump will deliver on his promise to secure the border, this threat will not go away. The truth is, without immediate action, these illegal aliens will be counted in the U.S. Census, which determines both the apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives _and_ the number of electoral votes given to each state. Whether they came because, four years ago, Kamala Harris and Joe Biden prompted them to “surge to the border” for asylum or because of blue-states offering sanctuary status, “free” health care, “free” cell phones, “free” housing, and “free” college...it doesn’t matter. The result is the same.Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in Congress. Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in the Electoral College.And every day reports are popping up of non-citizens, illegal aliens, and convicted felons being registered to vote in cities and entire swing-states across the country, which means your vote may be fully **canceled out in future elections**. **_American elections should be decided by American citizens._****[If you agree then please sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution so the chaos we’re seeing now _never_ happens again in America.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=5d7a0231b62f4877af24be1a7847f5d7&_e=TI2d88hqrWg5WfPuUNpzkAlM-ZH07herKICQb_vF38egA5TcER259VK4Paja3kbVMJfeUovGgavVGqXpsV2-9xFVzMHiP6nTdW96SmRZKVqazSpD93JPRolLjpi2UVPKmMe9UU589vUtLtrKbwuI-eDw4xKmlwxtzivshGnKnX8xv5izw4qydIdmg0Y7c7GUuY8cjzHgm6vq726p0wO46FySbS7Xvyxe_Ntd9RAk1AY9m5_VGTuR2uBecRRlbBANNG4acyrAnlg4xQdHdn9jdbbBxMmJKwz-BQiW-Mmw666bwuqU5P6H4us1Czhv7CwhqZUOpu-geXeY-VO5IZPmIV1KZiFwP7aGSBb2QUnveUY%3D)**Because, here’s the scary part:The last census took place in 2020. That was _before_ the 11.5 million illegal aliens who invaded our country under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. The Rise of Republicans in Latino California with Gustavo Arellano
The Latino Vote Podcast Season 2025 Episode 5
| Chuck and Mike sit down with **renowned columnist for the LA Times Gustavo Arellano** to unpack the **dramatic transformation in California’s Latino political landscape**. They explore how **the rise of Latino Republicans** —from a handful to a historic nine in Sacramento—is challenging traditional Democratic strongholds and redefining what it means to represent Latino communities. The lively discussion delves into generational divides, debates over immigration versus economic priorities, and even cultural quirks from lowrider pride to electric car mandates.

**Gustavo Arellano** is a columnist for the Los Angeles Times, covering Southern California everything and a bunch of the West and beyond. He previously worked at OC Weekly, where he was an investigative reporter for 15 years and editor for six, wrote a column called ¡Ask a Mexican! and is the author of “Taco USA: How Mexican Food Conquered America.”

After serving in the Peace Corps, my parents moved to the North Country and started a dairy farm. body:

---
Elon Musk recently ordered for an email to be sent to millions of federal workers with the subject like: “What did you do last week?” In the email, employees were ordered to share five bullet points detailing what they had accomplished at work in the last week. Musk himself said “Failure to respond will be taken as a resignation." Maybe you’ve had a micromanaging boss just like this before and you know the feeling. Maybe it made you want to just quit your job rather than having to justify your service and your career to some out-of-touch executive who doesn’t understand half of what you actually do. That’s exactly what they’re hoping will happen. But when I heard about this email, I wondered if Donald Trump was going to respond to Musk’s email and report on what he did last week. After all, a good boss will hold himself to the same standard that he holds his employees to, right? In order to prioritize _efficiency_ , I’ve taken the liberty of writing his bullet points for him:
* Purged the military of experienced and qualified senior officers, putting our national security at risk.
* Promised to protect Medicaid only to backtrack less than 24 hours later by endorsing the House Republican plan to cut health care to pay for tax cuts for the ultra-rich.
* Fired the experts working to end bird flu (as egg prices go WAY up). Now frantically trying to find and rehire them.
* Stopped the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau from helping people who get scammed by Wall Street and giant corporations.
* Put your grandma’s Social Security check in danger by forcing out the acting Social Security Commissioner.

I could go on, but these reports are supposed to be snappy. While Trump was up to all of this, public servants in the federal government were busy doing their jobs for the American people — everything from making sure you get your tax refund to researching breakthroughs in cancer treatments to making sure nursing homes got their payments from Medicaid. Again this is an explicit attempt to make civil servants so sick of working for the federal government that they decide to leave or lose their jobs for refusing to follow the orders of an unelected billionaire who they do not report to. It’s anti-worker. It’s anti-American. And, for all intents and purposes, it’s anti-efficiency.

Look: Trump and Musk are doing so much, so fast, to weaken our government institutions, make our country less safe, hurt working people, and reward the rich and powerful. They want it to be impossible to keep track of every outrageous action they take. But we are staying on it. We will keep calling out what they’re doing and making their true motives clear. And we will keep fighting back — in Congress, in the courts, and by raising our voices because our stories have power.
